NDTMS_OPERATING.md.content:
# NDTMS source projection in the existing service workspace

This extension adds a six-entity structural intake to the original Python/SQLite service workbench. It uses the existing source editions, immutable objects, reviewed cell corrections, task requests, mapping contracts, target returns, baseline/delta/rollback and complete receiving archive. It does not implement a supplier API, clinical decision system or statutory submission gateway.

## Install the complete source continuation

Use Python 3.10 or newer and the exact retained original application edition. The source composer uses only the standard library and writes a separate complete application directory. Its full-file preimage guards reject another or locally changed original edition.

```sh
python application/compose_ndtms_application.py --source ABS_ORIGINAL_APPLICATION --overlay ABS_NDTMS_OVERLAY_JSON --out ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION
```

The overlay is `ndtms-overlay.json` in this public source directory. It contains every complete changed/new application file and its bytes/SHA-256. The composer verifies every original APPLICATION.json member, preserves all unmodified source and original case documents locally, applies only matching postimages and generates a complete new APPLICATION.json. It does not alter a workspace or run the operator. Replaying the same output requires every complete composed byte to match. A changed source edition needs explicit composition with its actual current full source, not an override of the preimage guard.

Start the existing operator against the intended existing workspace:

```sh
python ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION/operator/server.py --workspace ABS_ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE
```

Open its printed loopback session URL. Keep that session token private; it is not source evidence and is excluded from portable archives. The new navigation item is **NDTMS source intake**. All original navigation and operations remain available.

## Select original data

Import a complete original CSV/TSV or source ZIP through **Source editions**. Choose the exact encoding and dialect. The workbench retains the original complete bytes, original headings, every string cell and one-based CSV record numbers, including quoted multiline cells. Existing supported encodings are UTF-8/BOM, UTF-16 and Windows-1252.

The public catalogue is `source/ndtms-cds-r-v1.3.json`, ID `ndtms-cds-r-technical-v1.3-20261013`, SHA-256 `decc19db8da3ce80ed7485629b6a8de8230a8c9152ea3e9e98ea1bc039b7f4f4`. It preserves all 290 published headers and source-derived layout/rule references. The reference blank CSV contains headers only. It is not populated clinical data.

The whole operator exposes this exact installed catalogue through its authenticated `GET /api/ndtms-profile`. Do not substitute an inferred later dataset or a supplier template.

Select an actual original edition/table, declared cohort and extraction scope. Cohorts are `adult`, `young-person`, `mixed`, `secure-setting` or `other-declared`. Record the actual published AD/YP/SA/SY population in the note. These declarations do not implement cohort-specific clinical applicability.

Scopes are `full`, `reporting` or `changed-since-prior-submission`. A partial/changed scope requires calendar from/to dates and a source-population note. Changed-only additionally requires a separate retained prior source edition, a source reference and an explicit relationship/limits note. The adapter retains that prior original object identity but does not infer its submission acceptance or completeness. A vendor-return baseline is a different original record and is not used as an NDTMS submission reference.

## Structural analysis and original corrections

The exact action is `analyse-ndtms`:

```json
{
  "editionId": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_EDITION_ID",
  "tableId": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_TABLE_ID",
  "profileId": "ndtms-cds-r-technical-v1.3-20261013",
  "cohort": "adult",
  "scope": {
    "kind": "full",
    "from": null,
    "to": null,
    "agency": "EXACT_SOURCE_AGENCY",
    "note": "Actual source population, authority and known exclusions."
  }
}
```

For a changed extract, add `scope.priorSubmission = {editionId, reference, note}` with the actual separate retained prior edition. No identifier is synthesized from a person name.

The analysis checks all exact unique published headers, source widths, opaque identities and parent ownership, Y/N consent, one child group per row, repeated entity equality, calendar dates, declared character maxima, unambiguous numeric shape and whitespace. Every source row remains in the full raw/effective artifact. Every projected witness retains original row identity/proof, effective hash, all applicable correction IDs, complete projected variant and extension values. Conflicting variants remain separate; a conflicted entity has `values: null`, not a chosen first/last value.

Every finding returns `rowIds` and `sourceRows:[{sourceRowId,sourceRow}]`, scoped to the actual edition/table. This includes invalid rows that could not form an entity. Open the original row, review a specific cell with its source basis and use the existing correction dialog. A correction never changes original bytes. Create a successor analysis; previous analyses, variants and artifacts stay immutable. Publishing a now-stale analysis is rejected.

### Consent partition

A native client with both consented and minimal no-consent episodes remains one native client. The normalized source adds explicitly generated `NDTMS_CONSENT_SCOPE` and separate Y/N client projections. It may therefore contain more client projection rows than native clients.

For N rows, only original AGNCY, CLIENTID, EPISODID and CONSENT values may be populated. Any other supplied value is retained as a finding and original source, never copied into the minimal projection. Y values do not fill blank N attributes. Generated keys/context are adapter metadata, not asserted supplier or NDTMS columns.

Normalized client key is AGNCY + CLIENTID + NDTMS_CONSENT_SCOPE. Episode-to-client joins include that partition. Episode key remains AGNCY + CLIENTID + EPISODID; changing consent for the same episode is a conflict. Child keys add their exact MODID, SUBMID, TOPID or CIRID.

## Publish and receive through the existing mapping workflow

`publish-ndtms` takes only `{analysisId}`. It checks structural readiness, the exact unchanged original/correction selection and complete immutable projection indexes before publishing. The resulting source ZIP contains precisely these six mapping tables:

| Table | Original source group |
| --- | --- |
| client | Columns 1–9 and native client identity |
| episode | Columns 10–103 and parent identity |
| intervention | Columns 104–110 |
| sir | Columns 111–190 |
| top_ypor | Columns 191–256 |
| cir | Columns 257–290 |

All six tables are present even when a group has zero records. The archive also retains the full original source/table bytes, catalogue, source/effective rows, entity variants, lineage, complete findings, manifest and readable HTML report. Original CSV/ZIP members are byte-identical `.bin` aliases under `originals/`; the manifest's original object references preserve their names and hashes. This avoids importing a seventh denormalized or blank table.

The archive enters the ordinary `import_edition` transaction. The operator opens this real edition in the existing mapping-contract builder. Select the actual vendor-approved columns, keys, relationships, transforms, complete exit format and permitted load route. No contract is automatically approved. A projection that is structurally ready is not clinical acceptance, successful supplier import or NDTMS acceptance.

Obtain actual returned files after the supplier's sanctioned load. Use the existing target-return binding and field comparison, retaining actual returned identities/versions only when the real supplier provides them. Original record absence does not authorize deletion. Complete exit scope, notes, attachments, history and any priced export work must be agreed separately with the supplier.

## CLI and interrupted continuation

The addon CLI uses the same Workspace writer. Supply a stable request ID and original expected revision, actor and complete data JSON:

```sh
python ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION/ndtms_cli.py --workspace ABS_WORKSPACE analyse --data ABS_SELECTION_JSON --request-id ORIGINAL_REQUEST_ID --expected-revision ORIGINAL_REVISION --actor-id ORIGINAL_ACTOR --actor-name "Original operator" --save-request ABS_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_JSON
python ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION/ndtms_cli.py --workspace ABS_WORKSPACE publish --data ABS_ANALYSIS_SELECTION_JSON --request-id ORIGINAL_PUBLICATION_REQUEST_ID --expected-revision ORIGINAL_REVISION --actor-id ORIGINAL_ACTOR --actor-name "Original operator" --save-request ABS_ORIGINAL_PUBLICATION_REQUEST_JSON
python ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION/ndtms_cli.py --workspace ABS_WORKSPACE status ORIGINAL_REQUEST_ID
```

The request file is saved completely before mutation. On retry, the CLI uses that original full request, verifies the same command/ID/revision/actor, and compares current data when its staging file still exists. Removed staging JSON does not prevent original replay. Changed data or reused identity rejects. Workspace resolves an already committed request before checking the current revision. Do not create a new request to guess around an unknown response.

Read-only commands `profile` and `blank` output the actual complete catalogue and blank header template. Original API pagination remains revision-bound and limited to 200 rows per page. New kinds are `ndtms-analysis`, `ndtms-findings`, `ndtms-rows` and `ndtms-lineage`; analysis filters use its actual analysisId.

## Meaningful native receiving in the existing programme

The included course uses labelled fictional data only:

```sh
python ABS_COMPOSED_APPLICATION/native/ndtms_receiving.py --work ABS_ORIGINAL_PROGRAMME_DIRECTORY --operation-id ORIGINAL_NDTMS_RECEIVING_OPERATION
```

It retains one kernel-backed owner lease, exact source/profile/input selection and every original request before mutation. Eight authored original rows exercise a repeated-episode conflict, all four child groups, repeated equal witnesses and mixed consent for one native client. A reviewed original correction produces ten normalized rows: three client partitions, three episodes and four child records.

The course then uses the real original mapping/approval/release, separate owned local target, full native returned files, accepted baseline, successor delta, actual stale-write refusal, field-level verification, rollback and independent complete workspace/application receiving. The local schema and target are explicitly authored examples; no supplier system is contacted.

Its result `NDTMS_NATIVE.json` retains all original source/analysis/correction/contract/target IDs, actual artifact paths, complete backup and original independent receiving. On replay it validates original request receipts and artifacts, uses the same original backup and preserves later source/target/recipient descendants. It does not generate a new backup into the original receiving destination after browser edits. Missing selected artifacts can be restored create-only from their full original immutable objects; changed bytes are preserved and rejected.

The optional original browser join is executable in the same command:

```sh
python ABS_EXECUTING_APPLICATION/native/ndtms_receiving.py --work ABS_ORIGINAL_PROGRAMME_DIRECTORY --operation-id ORIGINAL_NDTMS_RECEIVING_OPERATION --node ABS_EXISTING_NODE --playwright ABS_EXISTING_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_FILE --chromium ABS_EXISTING_CHROMIUM --attachments ABS_OUTGOING_SELECTION_JSON --application-archive ABS_EXACT_OUTGOING_APPLICATION_ZIP
```

All three runtime flags are supplied together. The optional attachment JSON is an array of exact absolute `{path,bytes,sha256}` identities. The named application archive must be one of those attachments; its complete root-level file inventory and embedded APPLICATION.json must match the actual executing source. Run this command from the application unpacked from that exact outgoing ZIP. Every selected file and the original manifest are retained before browser dispatch. Missing original staging can reopen from those bytes; changed input or runtime rejects.

The browser owner reuses the original maintained process/listener lifecycle. It operates the source workspace, retains its first complete backup and receives its actual destination, then starts the same original application there for independent browser reopening. Full native/browser IDs, inputs, phase results, screenshots, draft sidecars and every recovery branch remain under the original programme directory. No manually authored session JSON is required. The full operator and browser guide is [NDTMS_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md](NDTMS_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md).

A native `CORE_COMPLETE` result is separate from rendered delivery. Use the same existing operator/browser owner to open the source workspace and independent receiver, operate source findings/corrections/analysis/publication/mapping, inspect full reports and open complete downloaded archives. View desktop 1440 and narrow 390 widths, and personally LOOK at actual screenshots. Open every outgoing attachment and every applicable report/PDF page, use the important controls, download and reopen the exact result. Source review, parsing, metadata or another peer's approval does not satisfy this requirement. Retain precise actual gaps rather than claiming an unexecuted runtime.

## Limits and interpretation

Existing intake limits remain 512 MiB total/expanded input, 256 MiB per member, 250,000 rows across an imported edition, 20 CSV tables, 1,000 archive members and 2 MiB per cell. The projected six-table row sum must fit the original row limit. Source-row count does not equal normalized entity count. These are selection ceilings, not measured throughput or a commissioned population promise.

The catalogue identifies clinical/reference rules; this adapter does not claim to execute every reference list, sentinel, cohort applicability, historical introduction/trigger rule or intervention sequencing exception. Those remain explicitly listed in each analysis. Unknown, missing and zero source tokens remain distinct strings. Scope declarations, original supplier authority, full exit obligations and actual recipient acceptance remain visible responsibilities.

No new credentials, external send, buyer account, supplier API, watcher or controller is created by this addon.

NDTMS_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md.content:
# NDTMS source projection — operator and receiving guide

Edition: 2026-10-13. This guide belongs to the complete NDTMS continuation of the existing source, migration, actual-return and portable workspace application.

## What the application does

The application retains the complete original 290-column CSV, its source edition, every reviewed source-cell correction and each immutable analysis. It projects six populations: clients, episodes, interventions, SIR, TOP/YPOR and CIR. Every projected entity retains the complete original row witnesses and hashes. Conflicting repeated values remain visible; a conflicting projection cannot be published as a completed source.

Native clients use their exact agency and client ID. A client who has consented and non-consented episodes has two generated client privacy partitions, identified by NDTMS_CONSENT_SCOPE. Those partitions do not mean two people. A no-consent partition retains only the permitted identity/consent projection; it does not borrow protected attributes from the consented partition. The supplier mapping must explicitly bind the generated parent relationship.

Structural readiness means the implemented source checks pass. The analysis's **Actual structural coverage** names the implemented checks and the clinical, code-list, trigger, historic completeness, population and supplier acceptance checks that remain separate. Selecting a cohort declares the supplied population; it does not implement all cohort-specific clinical rules.

The six-table source continues through the application's existing explicit mapping, approvals, assessment, release, actual target return, baseline, delta, stale-write refusal, recovery and whole-workspace delivery. A supplier's real load route and returned record/identifier/change contract are agreed from its actual interface. The authored local receiving course exercises the application's own local target; it does not supply a vendor schema or authorize an external clinical load.

## Start with the original complete source

The source overlay is applied to the exact accepted complete application, in a separate directory. It verifies every original application member, each changed-file preimage, all complete postimages and the generated APPLICATION.json. It leaves the original application and workspace in place.

From the directory containing the maintained composer:

```sh
python3 compose_ndtms_application.py \
  --source /absolute/accepted-application \
  --overlay /absolute/ndtms-application-overlay.json \
  --out /absolute/composed-application
```

Use the actual supplied overlay filename. Retain the composition JSON, original application manifest and overlay. A repeat accepts the already composed output only after a full byte comparison. If the original application has advanced, reconcile the actual new source with the owner before selecting a different preimage.

To create a genuinely new blank workspace, run once from the composed application:

```sh
python3 cli.py --workspace /absolute/private-workspace init --name "NDTMS source workspace"
python3 operator/server.py --workspace /absolute/private-workspace
```

For an existing project, reuse its actual workspace directory and omit init. The operator prints its own loopback session URL; open that exact URL, including its session fragment. Keep the current session private. A received portable application starts from its own application directory and actual received workspace.

## Import and declare the source

1. Open **Sources** and import the complete authorised original CSV using the existing source-edition form. Keep its original filename and provenance. The public blank template has all 290 ordered headers and no patient rows.
2. Open **NDTMS**. The public catalogue is searchable by entity/field and supplies its exact original source references, field order and source definitions. Download its full JSON or blank CSV when needed.
3. Expand **Analyse an original source selection**. Select the actual retained **Original source edition** and **Original 290-column CSV table**.
4. Choose **Declared cohort** and **Extract scope**. Record the actual population, source authority, published cohort and previous-submission context in the source-scope note. Enter an exact agency code if the file is restricted to it. Leave the agency blank only for the explicitly described multi-agency population.
5. Enter extraction dates as supplied. A reporting period or changed-only extract does not establish complete clinical history. Never infer that absent people or records were deleted.
6. A changed-since-prior-submission extract requires **Prior submission source**: select a separately retained original edition, its actual submission reference and the attestation/context. Its source identity is frozen in the analysis. This is an operator source reference; statutory acceptance is still separately qualified.
7. Select **Analyse this retained source**. The operation uses the original workspace request ID, expected revision and actor journal. It retains its exact source/selection binding and complete output artifacts.

The exact selected profile is ndtms-cds-r-technical-v1.3-20261013. Its source catalogue is derived from the published CDS-R Technical Definitions v1.3 and retains all 290 fields. The current public definitions, reference data and relevant clinical owner remain the authority for their respective clinical meanings.

## Review every finding and correct an original cell

Choose a **Retained analysis**. The counts distinguish original rows, native clients, privacy partitions, consented/non-consented witnesses, conflicts and the six projected populations.

**Every source finding** links the actual original record ordinal, including rows that could not form a projection. Select **Record N** to open that exact source row. Use the existing reviewed-correction dialog to retain the original cell, replacement, actor and reason. The correction is an attributed overlay; the original file and prior analyses remain available.

Run a successor analysis on that same source selection. The earlier finding and all prior values remain in the earlier retained analysis. Inspect the successor's coverage and full report before publication.

Under **Projected entities and complete lineage**, select the entity and open **Inspect entity & witnesses**. The dialog shows the exact native key, consent partition, every complete projected variant, original row IDs/ordinals, raw and effective hashes and correction IDs. Equal repeated witnesses can support one entity. Different repeated values remain explicit conflicts.

A source correction is an engineering operation. Clinical meaning and the authority to change the real source remain with the responsible clinical/data owner.

## Publish and bind the actual receiving contract

**Publish complete six-entity source** is enabled only for a structurally ready retained analysis. It creates a real new original source edition, containing exactly six CSV tables. The complete source evidence and original flat input are retained as supporting non-CSV members, so the import does not accidentally interpret them as extra clinical tables.

Publication opens the existing **Mapping contracts** editor. Bind each source table to the actual supplier-provided target fields, exact identities and parent relationships. The generated client privacy partition must be explicitly handled. Do not turn an absent supplier version/change field into an invented column. Agree the real returned records and outcomes, available IDs/change indicators and independent-change comparison before rehearsal.

Continue the application's original workflow:

- Review and explicitly approve the complete mapping.
- Assess all selected source rows and resolve findings.
- Prepare a retained release for the agreed receiving route.
- Import complete actual returned files and compare every selected row/cell/identity.
- Establish a baseline from the actual return where appropriate.
- Prepare later deltas against the retained baseline and reject stale target state.
- Retain every receipt, failed request, complete response and recovery operation.
- Export the full editable workspace and complete application, then receive and reopen them independently.

The authored native course uses an explicitly selected owned local target to operate these transitions. Its target-only note field, IDs, versions and returned contracts are demonstration data, not a clinical supplier's promised format.

## Keep unfinished input and recover competing tabs

The analysis form has its own complete browser input draft, separate from the committed workspace. It retains unfinished dates, notes, cohort and prior-source selection.

**Download current input draft** saves all of that form input. **Open selected input draft** validates the whole portable file and workspace identity, downloads the current and incoming versions, asks for an explicit replacement and saves the selected incoming input.

Browser persistence uses a revision comparison inside one IndexedDB transaction. When two tabs edit the same saved draft, the second writer keeps its current writing and the earlier saved record. Use **Download both & open saved** or **Download both & use current** after reviewing the complete recovery download. Neither branch is silently overwritten.

If an input changes while an asynchronous saved/file read is pending, the application retains and downloads the differing versions and asks you to choose again from the current writing. A storage failure retains the current tab's input and its recovery controls.

The portable input limit is 8 MiB. This sidecar is not the committed workspace database. Save it alongside the complete workspace backup when unfinished writing is part of the handover. On another browser or receiving listener, open the same input draft through the actual controls.

## Full portable delivery and independent reopening

In **Full portable delivery**, use **Freeze complete workspace & application**. Download its **Complete ZIP** from the resulting retained backup row. The complete archive has the original workspace, object bytes, operation history, application source and manifest.

Use **Receive into a fresh owned directory** with that exact ZIP and a new owned destination. The resulting original receipt contains the actual destination, archive hash/size, original workspace identity, current workspace identity and complete application identity.

The received application is in destination/application and its workspace in destination/workspace. Start that application's operator with the received workspace. Verify the same retained analyses, original corrections, mapping and history; reopen the complete input sidecar if required. Further legitimate recipient edits belong to the received workspace and are preserved when the original archive is reconciled again.

An archive from a different source or a changed original file is not silently substituted into an existing receiving operation.

## One executable native operating course

Run the maintained native programme from the composed application. It owns only its own child processes through the original Programme lifecycle, including the existing parent-death and cancellation behavior.

Core source/target/recovery course:

```sh
python3 native/ndtms_receiving.py \
  --work /absolute/original-programme-directory \
  --operation-id ORIGINAL_OPERATION
```

Full source plus desktop/mobile browser and independent receiving course:

```sh
python3 native/ndtms_receiving.py \
  --work /absolute/original-programme-directory \
  --operation-id ORIGINAL_OPERATION \
  --node /absolute/node \
  --playwright /absolute/playwright-entry-module.mjs \
  --chromium /absolute/chromium \
  --attachments /absolute/selected-attachments.json
```

For the actual outgoing blank application ZIP, extract its complete members into a new directory and run that extracted application's same native course. Add --application-archive /absolute/selected-application.zip. That exact ZIP must also appear in the attachment manifest. Its APPLICATION.json and every complete inventory member must match the executing application; the archive has those files at its root, without a wrapper directory or extra members. This uses one course over the actual outgoing source, including its complete independent receiver.

The three runtime flags are supplied together. Playwright is the actual entry module file, not a node_modules directory. The optional attachments argument requires that runtime.

The selected attachment manifest is a plain JSON array of up to 64 exact entries:

```json
[
  {
    "path": "/absolute/original-attachment.html",
    "bytes": 12345,
    "sha256": "the actual complete 64-character lowercase SHA-256"
  }
]
```

The example size/hash are placeholders, not an accepted source selection. Generate the actual manifest from the frozen complete files. The programme copies the original manifest and every complete selected file into its own browser-inputs before browser dispatch, and binds the runtime and selection to the original operation. Rerun the same command, directory, operation and original input selection after interruption. Reconcile actual existing output instead of inventing a new run ID.

Without the browser runtime the result is CORE_COMPLETE. The complete browser invocation returns schema nelc.ndtms-complete-receiving/v1, state RECEIVING_COMPLETE, the frozen native result, sourceBrowser, receivedBrowser, exact input selection, original archive replay and current workspace heads.

### What the real native course operates

The source fixture is explicitly authored fictional data: eight 290-column flat rows, two native clients, three consent privacy partitions, three episodes and four child records, resulting in ten normalized rows. It includes a repeated CMSID conflict at original CSV record 7. The course retains the blocked analysis, reviews that cell to the authored original, publishes the successor and operates the real local target load, return, baseline, delta, stale refusal, rollback and complete independent archive receive.

The source browser then imports that exact authored CSV as its own named browser edition and operates:

- The actual complete profile and blank-template downloads.
- The original blocked finding, record-7 correction and successor analysis.
- Every consent partition and complete witness detail.
- The full report opened at 1440-pixel and 390-pixel widths and print output.
- Six-table publication into the original mapping editor, explicit approval and complete ten-row assessment.
- Mobile navigation and visible input controls.
- A real two-tab draft conflict retaining both complete branches.
- Portable input download, explicit reopen and cold browser reload.
- The actual complete workspace ZIP and independent receiving operation.
- Every selected HTML outgoing attachment at desktop/mobile widths and print output.

The received browser opens the actual directory returned by the source's original receiving receipt. It verifies the retained analysis, correction and six-table mapping, restores the input sidecar through the UI, cold-reopens it and captures desktop/mobile/history views.

The addon uses caller-owned page/context; it does not launch or close another controller's browser. The original native/browser.mjs owns the browser and request capture. Every workspace task is retained before dispatch and reconciled by its original request ID. The installed APPLICATION.json, every application member and selected attachment are checked before and after the course, including completed replay.

Each fresh resumed browser context restores the actual complete input sidecar. All before/incoming recovery files have immutable content-derived names and remain in the journal. An existing recovery filename is reused only for exactly matching bytes. Earlier competing writing and original backups remain preserved.

### Finish the actual visual inspection

The producer opens the actual returned screenshots and exact files, checks the desktop and 390-pixel layouts, readable labels and controls, full report/print output and every outgoing attachment. Record the specific original result and attachment identities that were personally viewed. Images existing on disk and a source-level review alone do not complete this step.

The maintained callback opens HTML attachments. For other selected formats, the equipped producer must also open the actual file using its appropriate viewer or the application: the complete ZIP through its original receiver, the full reference JSON through the relevant application/input controls, and CSV through a real readable table view. Preserve those actual file identities with the same receiving record.

## Original CLI and paging contract

The companion CLI reads the same installed catalogue and original workspace:

```sh
python3 ndtms_cli.py profile
python3 ndtms_cli.py blank
python3 ndtms_cli.py --workspace /absolute/private-workspace status ORIGINAL_REQUEST_ID
```

For analyse/publish, supply the complete data JSON, original request ID, exact expected revision, actor ID/name and --save-request path. The CLI stores the full request before invoking the original mutation; it refuses a differing existing request file.

Analysis data contains editionId, tableId, profileId, cohort and scope. Scope has kind, from/to (ISO date or null), agency, note and, when changed-only, priorSubmission with editionId/reference/note. Publish data is simply the exact analysisId.

Read-only pages ndtms-findings, ndtms-rows and ndtms-lineage use the original page envelope, selected workspace revision, offset and limit. Findings retain direct original sourceRows references even for malformed records. A conflicted projected row has values:null; complete variants remain in lineage.

## Primary definition sources

The public index is https://www.ndtms.net/ResourcesAndTraining/Documentation . The installed profile retains exact source URLs and field locators for the published CDS-R material.

- Technical Definitions CDS-R v1.3: the original ordered 290-field catalogue.
- CSV File Format Specification CDS-R v1.0: the flat-file/entity representation.
- Community Adult Business Definitions CDS-R v1.4: adult business meanings and consent context.
- Reference Data CDS-R v1.4: original reference codes.
- Geographic Information v15.1: geographic definitions.

Retain actual later public definitions as a new reviewed source edition rather than silently rewriting a frozen analysis. For another cohort, statutory extract or supplier interface, the responsible owner confirms the actual applicable definitions and receiving contract.

README.md.content:
# Service data and NDTMS source workspace

This is the complete blank local application. It contains no patient records, customer workspace, supplier tenant or previous commercial case.

## Open the application

Use Linux or macOS with Python 3.11 or later. The application uses the Python standard library; normal operation does not require Node or a browser automation package.

Extract the complete ZIP into an application directory. Keep all files together. From that directory:

```sh
python3 cli.py --workspace /absolute/private-workspace init --name "Service data review"
python3 operator/server.py --workspace /absolute/private-workspace
```

Open the exact local URL printed by the second command. The URL includes the session token for that listener; keep it private. Stop the listener with Ctrl+C when finished. Start it again with the same workspace path to resume its original source, corrections and history.

## Prepare and review an extract

Open **NDTMS source** in the navigation. Inspect the published catalogue and download the full blank 290-column CSV. Import an authorized original extract in Sources, then select its exact edition/table and declared scope in the NDTMS view.

Keep blocked findings and complete witnesses. A reviewed source-cell correction creates a new source projection; it does not overwrite the original. A ready structural analysis can publish the six complete normalized tables into the same workspace. Review the actual receiving supplier's keys, field mappings and permitted route in Mapping contracts before any release.

The application does not assert complete clinical-rule coverage, consent eligibility, regulatory submission acceptance or a supplier API. Its record and report state describe exactly what has been checked.

## Preserve the complete work

Use Delivery to freeze the full workspace and application and receive that exact archive independently. Source history, raw inputs, corrected values, mappings and returned versions remain together. Download and explicitly reopen unfinished NDTMS input drafts as their separate portable sidecar; browser draft storage is not part of a SQLite-only copy.

Read NDTMS_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md for the complete user course and NDTMS_OPERATING.md for source, CLI, consent partition and receiving contracts.

## Producing this outgoing edition

The included native/ndtms_receiving.py runs the labelled fictional receiving course through the original engine and optional browser owner. With --application-archive and the exact attachments manifest, it verifies that this running application is every member of the selected outgoing ZIP. Existing Node/Playwright/Chromium are used only for that producer course.

The producing operator must open, use and look at the actual outgoing version, every attachment, complete report and usable archive contents. Actual screenshots require personal inspection. Source hashes and automated results are retained evidence; they do not establish visible presentation quality.

## Source ancestry

This distribution preserves the maintained original Python/SQLite workbench code and its public aggregate NHS reference dependency, plus the source-qualified NDTMS extension. Original commercial and case documents are not included. SOURCE_ANCESTRY.json records exact original and overlay identities; APPLICATION.json identifies every complete member. The separate original-case continuation keeps its full prior package intact.

"""Inspect the selected original NHS ZIP and workbook without acquiring a new source."""
from __future__ import annotations
import csv,hashlib,io,json,re,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from nelc.common import check_stop,file_hash,require

MAIN="{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
REL="{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"
PACKAGE="{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}"
NOTE=re.compile(r"suppress|denominator|not applicable|not available|missing|symbol|notation|disclos|data quality|rounding|not collected|not reported",re.I)

def inspect_originals(zip_path,workbook_path,profile,signal=None):
    source=next(x for x in profile["retained_files"] if x["name"].endswith(".zip"))
    require(file_hash(Path(zip_path),signal)==(source["sha256"],source["bytes"]),
            "NHS_ORIGINAL_HASH","The selected original CSV ZIP differs from the retained source.")
    tables=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as archive:
        actual={x.filename for x in archive.infolist() if not x.is_dir()}
        require(actual=={x["name"] for x in source["members"]},"NHS_ORIGINAL_MEMBERS","The original CSV member inventory differs.")
        for spec in source["members"]:
            check_stop(signal);raw=archive.read(spec["name"])
            require((hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw))==(spec["sha256"],spec["bytes"]),
                    "NHS_ORIGINAL_MEMBER","The original CSV member differs from its retained bytes.",spec["name"])
            reader=csv.reader(io.StringIO(raw.decode(spec["encoding"]),newline=""));headers=next(reader)
            require(headers==spec["header"],"NHS_ORIGINAL_HEADERS","The original CSV headers differ.",spec["name"])
            count=0;selected=[];tokens={":":0,"*":0,"z":0};widths={}
            for ordinal,row in enumerate(reader,2):
                check_stop(signal);count+=1;widths[len(row)]=widths.get(len(row),0)+1
                if len(row)==len(headers) and row[headers.index("OrgCode")]=="E06000012":
                    selected.append(ordinal)
                    for value in row:
                        if value in tokens:tokens[value]+=1
            require(count==spec["data_rows"] and len(selected)==spec["north_east_lincolnshire_rows"],
                    "NHS_ORIGINAL_COUNTS","The original complete and authority counts differ.",spec["name"])
            tables.append({"name":spec["name"],"sha256":spec["sha256"],"bytes":spec["bytes"],"headers":headers,
                           "rows":count,"authorityCode":"E06000012","selectedRows":len(selected),
                           "selectedSourceRows":selected,"selectedRawTokenCounts":tokens,"widthCounts":widths})
    workbook_sha,workbook_bytes=file_hash(Path(workbook_path),signal)
    require(workbook_bytes==1500509,"NHS_WORKBOOK_LENGTH","Select the retained original annual workbook.")
    sheets=[];notes=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(workbook_path) as archive:
        require(sum(x.file_size for x in archive.infolist())<=256*1024*1024,
                "NHS_WORKBOOK_EXPANSION","The selected original workbook exceeds its bounded inspection.")
        strings=[]
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in archive.namelist():
            for item in ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall(MAIN+"si"):
                strings.append("".join(n.text or "" for n in item.iter(MAIN+"t")))
        relationships={}
        for relation in ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels")).findall(PACKAGE+"Relationship"):
            target=relation.get("Target","")
            if relation.get("TargetMode")=="External":continue
            member=target.lstrip("/") if target.startswith("/") else "xl/"+target
            require(".." not in Path(member).parts,"NHS_WORKBOOK_MEMBER","The workbook relationship leaves its original archive.")
            relationships[relation.get("Id")]=member
        workbook=ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        for sheet in workbook.findall(MAIN+"sheets/"+MAIN+"sheet"):
            check_stop(signal);member=relationships[sheet.get(REL+"id")]
            if not member.startswith("xl/worksheets/"):continue
            raw=archive.read(member);body=ET.fromstring(raw);rows=[]
            for row in body.findall(MAIN+"sheetData/"+MAIN+"row"):
                cells=[]
                for cell in row.findall(MAIN+"c"):
                    value=cell.find(MAIN+"v");kind=cell.get("t")
                    if kind=="s" and value is not None:
                        text=strings[int(value.text)]
                    elif kind=="inlineStr":
                        text="".join(x.text or "" for x in cell.iter(MAIN+"t"))
                    else:text=value.text if value is not None else ""
                    if text:cells.append({"cell":cell.get("r"),"value":text,"type":kind or "native-number",
                                         "formula":cell.findtext(MAIN+"f")})
                if cells:rows.append({"row":row.get("r"),"cells":cells})
            sheet_meta={"name":sheet.get("name"),"member":member,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"nonemptyRows":len(rows)}
            sheets.append(sheet_meta)
            selected=set()
            named_notes=bool(re.search(r"note|guide|content|cover|quality|read|intro|definition",sheet.get("name",""),re.I))
            for index,row in enumerate(rows):
                values=[x["value"] for x in row["cells"]]
                if named_notes or any(NOTE.search(value) for value in values) or (any(v in (":","*","z") for v in values) and any(len(v)>30 and re.search("[A-Za-z]",v) for v in values)):
                    selected.update(range(max(0,index-1),min(len(rows),index+2)))
            if selected:notes.append({**sheet_meta,"rows":[rows[index] for index in sorted(selected)]})
    return {"schema":"nelc.original-source-inspection/v1",
            "zip":{"sha256":source["sha256"],"bytes":source["bytes"],"tables":tables},
            "workbook":{"sha256":workbook_sha,"bytes":workbook_bytes,"sheets":sheets,"noteRows":notes},
            "interpretation":"Exact source cells are retained for review. Token meanings are not assigned automatically; all original :, *, z strings stay unchanged."}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install one complete hash-verified NELC source map; perform no application operation."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,sqlite3,sys
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath

def require(value,message):
    if not value:raise ValueError(message)
def checked_path(value):
    require(isinstance(value,str) and value and "\\" not in value and "\x00" not in value,"Invalid source path.")
    path=PurePosixPath(value)
    require(not path.is_absolute() and str(path)==value and all(p not in ("",".","..") for p in path.parts),"Source path leaves the selected application.")
    return path
def ordinary_parents(root,path):
    parent=root
    require(not root.is_symlink(),"The selected source directory cannot be a symlink.")
    for part in path.parts:
        parent=parent/part
        require(not parent.is_symlink(),"A source parent cannot be a symlink.")
        parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        require(parent.is_dir(),"A source parent is not a directory.")
def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("source_map");parser.add_argument("--output",required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    original=Path(args.source_map).read_bytes();packet=json.loads(original)
    require(packet.get("schema")=="commons.source-map/v1" and isinstance(packet.get("files"),dict),"Select the complete original source-map object.")
    files={}
    for name,item in packet["files"].items():
        relative=checked_path(name)
        require(isinstance(item,dict) and isinstance(item.get("content"),str),"Source members must contain complete original UTF-8 text.")
        body=item["content"].encode("utf-8")
        require((len(body),hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest())==(item["bytes"],item["sha256"]),"A source body differs from its manifest: "+name)
        files[name]=(relative,body,item["sha256"])
    require("APPLICATION.json" in files,"The complete application manifest is missing.")
    app=json.loads(files["APPLICATION.json"][1])
    require(app.get("schema")=="nelc.application-source/v1","Unsupported complete application edition.")
    wanted={item["path"]:item for item in app["files"]}
    require(len(wanted)==len(app["files"]) and set(files)==set(wanted)|{"APPLICATION.json"},"The carrier and application source inventory differ.")
    for name,item in wanted.items():
        require((len(files[name][1]),files[name][2])==(item["bytes"],item["sha256"]),"The application selection differs: "+name)
    root=Path(args.output).absolute();root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(),"Select an ordinary owned source directory.")
    owner_path=root/".source-install.sqlite"
    require(not owner_path.is_symlink(),"The source owner path cannot be a symlink.")
    owner=sqlite3.connect(owner_path,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
    try:
        owner.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS selected(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,application_sha TEXT NOT NULL)")
        owner.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        app_sha=files["APPLICATION.json"][2]
        prior=owner.execute("SELECT application_sha FROM selected WHERE id=1").fetchone()
        require(prior is None or prior[0]==app_sha,"This source directory already belongs to another complete application.")
        if prior is None:owner.execute("INSERT INTO selected VALUES(1,?)",(app_sha,))
        owner.execute("COMMIT");owner.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        for name,(relative,body,sha) in sorted(files.items(),key=lambda entry:(entry[0]=="APPLICATION.json",entry[0])):
            ordinary_parents(root,relative.parent)
            target=root/str(relative)
            require(not target.is_symlink(),"A selected source file cannot be a symlink.")
            if target.exists():
                require(target.is_file() and target.read_bytes()==body,"A selected installed source differs: "+name)
                continue
            temp=target.with_name("."+target.name+"."+sha[:16]+".source-receiving")
            require(not temp.is_symlink() and (not temp.exists() or temp.is_file()),"A source staging path is not ordinary.")
            with temp.open("wb") as stream:
                stream.write(body);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            require(temp.read_bytes()==body,"An installed source member is incomplete.")
            try:os.link(temp,target)
            except FileExistsError:require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink() and target.read_bytes()==body,"The selected source publication differs.")
            temp.unlink()
            fd=os.open(target.parent,os.O_RDONLY)
            try:os.fsync(fd)
            finally:os.close(fd)
        for name,(_,body,sha) in files.items():
            require((root/name).is_file() and not (root/name).is_symlink() and (root/name).read_bytes()==body,"The complete source readback differs: "+name)
        owner.execute("COMMIT")
        print(json.dumps({"schema":"nelc.source-install/v1","status":"COMPLETE","application":str(root),
             "applicationSha256":app_sha,"sourceMapSha256":hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),"files":len(files),
             "sourceBytes":sum(len(body) for _,body,_ in files.values()),"applicationOperationStarted":False},indent=2))
    finally:owner.close()
    return 0
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Continue the original programme with labelled authored NDTMS data and owned receiving."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, io, json, os, signal, sqlite3, sys, threading, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
APPLICATION=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(APPLICATION))
from nelc.common import *
from nelc.workspace import Workspace
from nelc.ndtms import profile_document, PROFILE_ID, PROFILE_SHA256, KEYS, SCOPE_COLUMN
from nelc.portable import application_files,backup
from receive_workspace import receive_archive
from ndtms_cli import retained_request
from native.receiving import Programme as OriginalProgramme

ACTOR={"id":"ndtms-authored-receiving","name":"Authored NDTMS receiving operator"}
def fixture():
    profile,raw=profile_document();headers=[f["header"] for f in profile["fields"]]
    def row(changes):
        require(set(changes)<=set(headers),"NATIVE_FIXTURE","The authored source uses an unknown original header.")
        values=dict.fromkeys(headers,"")
        values.update(changes);return [values[h] for h in headers]
    base={"AGNCY":"EX001","CLIENTID":"authored-client-01","EPISODID":"authored-episode-01",
          "CONSENT":"Y","FINITIAL":"A","SINITIAL":"Z","DOB":"19800101","CMSID":"authored-original"}
    records=[
      row({**base,"MODID":"authored-intervention-01","MODST":"20260402","MODAL":"96","MODSET":"99"}),
      row({**base,"SUBMID":"authored-sir-01","SUBMODDT":"20260403","PHDOSBUP":"2.5"}),
      row({**base,"TOPID":"authored-top-01","TOPDATE":"20260404","ALCUSE":"99","CONSMP":"0.0"}),
      row({**base,"CIRID":"authored-cir-01","CIRDT":"20260405","CIRHEPBSTAT":"N"}),
      row({**base,"MODID":"authored-intervention-01","MODST":"20260402","MODAL":"96","MODSET":"99"}),
      row({**base,"CMSID":"authored-conflict"}),
      row({"AGNCY":"EX001","CLIENTID":"authored-client-01","EPISODID":"authored-no-consent","CONSENT":"N"}),
      row({"AGNCY":"EX001","CLIENTID":"authored-client-02","EPISODID":"authored-episode-02","CONSENT":"Y",
           "FINITIAL":"B","SINITIAL":"Z","DOB":"19810101","CMSID":"authored-second"})
    ]
    return csv_bytes(headers,records),headers

class Course(OriginalProgramme):
    def __init__(self,args,stop):
        self.args=args;self.stop=stop;self.children=[];self.child_logs=[];self.root=Path(args.work).absolute()
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        require(self.root.is_dir() and not self.root.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_ROOT","Use the same ordinary programme work directory.")
        lock=self.root/"ndtms-owner.sqlite";require(not lock.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_ROOT","The native owner file is not ordinary.")
        self.owner=sqlite3.connect(lock,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
        try:
            self.owner.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owner(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
            self.owner.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            self.owner.close();raise Problem("NATIVE_IN_USE","The original NDTMS programme still has an active process.")
        try:
            app_sha,files=application_files(APPLICATION,stop)
            self.csv,self.headers=fixture()
            binding={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-native-selection/v1","operationId":args.operation_id,
                     "applicationSha256":app_sha,"profileSha256":PROFILE_SHA256,
                     "authoredInput":{"bytes":len(self.csv),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(self.csv).hexdigest()},
                     "scope":"Fictional structural receiving example only; no real people, supplier tenant or clinical acceptance."}
            self.path=self.root/"NDTMS_NATIVE.json"
            if self.path.exists():
                require(not self.path.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_JOURNAL","Use the original regular journal.")
                self.state=json.loads(self.path.read_text("utf-8"))
                require(self.state["selection"]==binding,"NATIVE_SELECTION","Resume the same source/application/operation.")
            else:
                allowed={"ndtms-owner.sqlite","ndtms-owner.sqlite-journal","ndtms-owner.sqlite-wal","ndtms-owner.sqlite-shm"}
                require(all(p.name in allowed for p in self.root.iterdir()),"NATIVE_ROOT","Use a fresh programme directory or its original journal.")
                self.state={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-native-receiving/v1","selection":binding,"steps":{},"createdAt":now()};self.save()
            self.requests=self.root/"requests";self.requests.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            self.output=self.root/"artifacts";self.output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            self.sender=self.open("source-workspace");self.target=self.open("owned-target-workspace")
        except BaseException:
            self.owner.close();raise
    def close(self):
        super().close()
    def save(self):
        atomic_bytes(self.path,(canonical(self.state)+"\n").encode("utf-8"))
    def open(self,name):
        path=self.root/name
        return Workspace(path) if (path/"workspace.sqlite").is_file() else Workspace(path,create=True,name="Authored NDTMS "+name)
    def step(self,name,workspace,action,data):
        path=self.requests/(name+".json")
        if path.exists():
            request=json.loads(path.read_text("utf-8"))
            require(request["action"]==action and request["data"]==data and request["actor"]==ACTOR,
                    "NATIVE_REQUEST_CHANGED","Preserve the exact original receiving request.",name)
        else:
            request={"requestId":self.args.operation_id+":"+name,"expectedRevision":workspace.metadata()["revision"],
                     "actor":ACTOR,"action":action,"data":data}
            retained_request(path,request)
        result=workspace.mutate(request,self.stop)
        previous=self.state["steps"].get(name)
        if previous:require(previous["operationId"]==result["operationId"] and previous["result"]==result["result"],
                            "NATIVE_RECEIPT_CHANGED","The retained original step differs.")
        else:self.state["steps"][name]=result;self.save()
        return result["result"]
    def rows(self,workspace,kind,selection):
        revision=workspace.metadata()["revision"];offset=0;items=[]
        while True:
            page=workspace.page(kind,selection,revision,offset,200);items.extend(page["items"])
            if page["nextOffset"] is None:return items
            offset=page["nextOffset"]
    def transfer(self,source,target,ref):
        with source.connect() as db:path=source.object(db,ref,self.stop)
        with path.open("rb") as stream:copied=target.put_stream(stream,ref["name"],signal=self.stop)
        require((copied["sha256"],copied["bytes"])==(ref["sha256"],ref["bytes"]),"NATIVE_TRANSFER","The original transferred bytes differ.")
        return copied
    def returned(self,name,contract,export):
        archive=self.transfer(self.target,self.sender,export["archive"]);mf=self.transfer(self.target,self.sender,export["manifest"])
        ed=self.step(name+"-edition",self.sender,"import-edition",{"name":name+" complete owned local return","object":archive,
            "source":{"kind":"owned-local-export","manifest":mf},"csv":{"default":{"encoding":"utf-8-sig"}}})
        tables=[]
        for row in export["snapshot"]["tables"]:
            table=next(t for t in ed["tables"] if t["name"]==row["file"])
            require(table["headers"]==row["headers"],"NATIVE_RETURN","The owned return headers changed.")
            tables.append({k:row[k] for k in ("mappingId","fields","identityColumn","versionColumn","dispositionColumn","dispositions")}|
                          {"tableId":table["id"]})
        value=self.step(name,self.sender,"import-target-return",{"contractId":contract["id"],"editionId":ed["id"],
            "kind":"owned-local-export","basis":"Actual export of the owned authored receiving database; not a supplier system.",
            "completeSnapshot":True,"coverageNote":"Every record and table in the authored local target.","tables":tables})
        require(value["ready"] and value["snapshotSha256"]==export["snapshot"]["snapshotSha256"],"NATIVE_RETURN","Complete returned rows differ.")
        return value
    def release(self,name,contract):
        self.step(name+"-approval",self.sender,"approve-contract",{"contractId":contract["id"],
            "definitionSha256":contract["definitionSha256"],"sourceReviewed":True,"authorityConfirmed":True,
            "reason":"Reviewed explicit authored local schema and separate consent partition; no supplier or clinical approval."})
        assessment=self.step(name+"-assessment",self.sender,"assess",{"contractId":contract["id"]})
        require(assessment["ready"] and assessment["mappedRows"]==10,"NATIVE_ASSESSMENT","The ten authored normalized rows and parent relationships must agree.")
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"release",{"contractId":contract["id"],"assessmentId":assessment["id"],
            "name":name,"reason":"Release the complete exact authored local receiving contract only."})
    def apply(self,name,target,plan):
        archive=self.transfer(self.sender,self.target,plan["archive"])
        return self.step(name,self.target,"apply-local-plan",{"targetId":target["id"],"archive":archive,"planId":plan["id"],"confirmOwnedLocal":True})
    def compare(self,name,release,current,baseline):
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"compare-target",{"releaseId":release["id"],"currentReturnId":current["id"],
            "baselineId":baseline["id"],"name":name,"reason":"Compare every actual returned field, preserving later target edits."})
    def plan(self,name,comparison):
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"plan-delta",{"comparisonId":comparison["id"],"allEligible":True,
            "reason":name+" explicitly selects eligible authored local rows only."})
    def verify(self,name,plan,current):
        v=self.step(name,self.sender,"verify-plan",{"planId":plan["id"],"returnId":current["id"],"reason":"Read back every field and actual local disposition."})
        require(v["allFieldsMatched"] and v["allRowsAccepted"],"NATIVE_VERIFICATION","The full local return did not match.")
        return v
    def export_object(self,name,workspace,ref):
        with workspace.connect() as db:source=workspace.object(db,ref,self.stop)
        path=self.output/name
        def exact():
            require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and file_hash(path,self.stop)==(ref["sha256"],ref["bytes"]),
                    "NATIVE_OUTPUT","Preserve the differing original artifact.")
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():exact()
        else:
            fd,temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".ndtms-artifact-",dir=self.output)
            try:
                with source.open("rb") as body,os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as target:
                    while True:
                        check_stop(self.stop);chunk=body.read(1024*1024)
                        if not chunk:break
                        target.write(chunk)
                    target.flush();os.fsync(target.fileno())
                require(file_hash(temporary,self.stop)==(ref["sha256"],ref["bytes"]),"NATIVE_OUTPUT","The complete copied artifact differs.")
                try:os.link(temporary,path)
                except FileExistsError:exact()
                directory=os.open(self.output,os.O_RDONLY)
                try:os.fsync(directory)
                finally:os.close(directory)
            finally:
                try:os.unlink(temporary)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
        return {"path":str(path),"sha256":ref["sha256"],"bytes":ref["bytes"]}

    def completed(self):
        result=self.state.get("result")
        if result is None:return None
        require(result.get("state")=="CORE_COMPLETE" and result["selection"]==self.state["selection"],
                "NATIVE_RESULT","Retain the original complete receiving result.")
        by_id={self.sender.metadata()["id"]:self.sender,self.target.metadata()["id"]:self.target}
        for label,saved in self.state["steps"].items():
            workspace=by_id.get(saved["workspaceId"])
            require(workspace is not None,"NATIVE_WORKSPACE","The completed request belongs to another original workspace.")
            request_path=self.requests/(label+".json")
            require(request_path.is_file() and not request_path.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_REQUEST","Retain every complete original request.")
            request=json.loads(request_path.read_text("utf-8"));retained_request(request_path,request)
            observed=workspace.operation(request["requestId"])
            require(observed is not None and all(observed[k]==saved[k] for k in ("operationId","requestId","workspaceId","revision","action","result"))
                    and observed["operationId"]=="operation-"+digest(request)[:28],
                    "NATIVE_RECEIPT_CHANGED","The original saved request/commit changed.",label)
        failed=self.state.get("staleRejection")
        require(failed is not None,"NATIVE_FAILED_REQUEST","Retain the actual stale-request refusal.")

    def run(self):

        blocked=self.step("conflicting-analysis",self.sender,"analyse-ndtms",data)

        raw_rows=self.rows(self.sender,"source-rows",{"editionId":ed["id"],"tableId":table["id"]})

        normalized=published["edition"]

        mappings=[]

            mappings.append({"id":entity,"entity":"Authored "+entity,"sourceTableId":t["id"],"sourceKey":[t["headers"].index(h) for h in keys],
                "scope":[],"target":{"table":entity+".csv","key":keys,"encoding":"utf-8-sig","delimiter":",",
                "allowRollbackDeleteCreated":True,"columns":[{"name":h,"source":i,"transform":"identity","type":"text","required":h in keys}
