        relationships=[{"id":"episode_client","fromTable":"episode","toTable":"client",
            "fromFields":["AGNCY","CLIENTID",SCOPE_COLUMN],"toFields":["AGNCY","CLIENTID",SCOPE_COLUMN],
            "cardinality":"many-to-one","required":True,"reason":"Generated adapter privacy partition; never enrich minimal N rows from consented Y client projections."}]
        for entity in KEYS:
            if entity in ("client","episode"):continue
            relationships.append({"id":entity+"_episode","fromTable":entity,"toTable":"episode",
                "fromFields":KEYS["episode"],"toFields":KEYS["episode"],"cardinality":"many-to-one","required":True,
                "reason":"Exact original agency/client/episode tuple in the authored local schema."})
        definition={"name":"Authored six-entity local receiving contract","authority":"Owned example only; not a vendor schema",
                    "editionId":normalized["id"],"tables":mappings,"relationships":relationships,"rules":[],"sourceTokens":{}}
        contract=self.step("explicit-owned-contract",self.sender,"save-contract",{"definition":definition})
        initial=self.release("initial-reviewed-release",contract)
        target=self.step("open-owned-target",self.target,"open-local-target",{"name":"Independent authored NDTMS target",
            "manifest":self.transfer(self.sender,self.target,initial["manifest"]),
            "archive":self.transfer(self.sender,self.target,initial["archive"]),"confirmOwnedLocal":True})
        empty=self.returned("empty-return",contract,self.step("empty-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]}))
        baseline=self.step("empty-baseline",self.sender,"accept-baseline",{"returnId":empty["id"],"snapshotSha256":empty["snapshotSha256"],"reason":"Actual complete empty owned target."})
        comparison=self.compare("initial-comparison",initial,empty,baseline)
        plan=self.plan("initial-plan",comparison);receipt=self.apply("initial-apply",target,plan)
        received=self.returned("initial-return",contract,self.step("initial-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]}))
        self.verify("initial-verification",plan,received)
        accepted=self.step("accepted-baseline",self.sender,"accept-baseline",{"returnId":received["id"],"snapshotSha256":received["snapshotSha256"],"reason":"Full actual local returned field/identity/disposition comparison."})
        next_definition=json.loads(canonical(contract["definition"]))
        for m in next_definition["tables"]:m["target"]["columns"][-1]["constant"]="Authored successor"
        following=self.step("successor-contract",self.sender,"save-contract",{"definition":next_definition,"supersedes":contract["id"],"reason":"Change only authored target-only receiving notes."})
        next_release=self.release("successor-release",following)
        changes=self.compare("successor-comparison",next_release,received,accepted)
        delta=self.plan("successor-plan",changes);stale=self.plan("separate-stale-plan",changes)
        delta_receipt=self.apply("successor-apply",target,delta)
        stale_archive=self.transfer(self.sender,self.target,stale["archive"])
        failure_name="stale-apply-rejection"
        failure_data={"targetId":target["id"],"archive":stale_archive,"planId":stale["id"],"confirmOwnedLocal":True}
        failed=self.state.get("staleRejection")
        if failed:
            original_request=json.loads((self.requests/(failure_name+".json")).read_text("utf-8"))
            require(digest(original_request)==failed["requestSha256"] and original_request["action"]=="apply-local-plan"
                    and original_request["data"]==failure_data and original_request["actor"]==ACTOR
                    and self.target.operation(original_request["requestId"]) is None,
                    "NATIVE_FAILED_REQUEST","Retain the exact refused request and its unchanged absence of a committed operation.")
        else:
            try:self.step(failure_name,self.target,"apply-local-plan",failure_data)
            except Problem as error:
                require(error.code in ("TARGET_SNAPSHOT_STALE","LOCAL_RECORD_STALE"),
                        "NATIVE_STALE_CODE","The original target returned an unexpected error.",error.as_dict())
                original_request=json.loads((self.requests/(failure_name+".json")).read_text("utf-8"))
                require(self.target.operation(original_request["requestId"]) is None,"NATIVE_FAILED_REQUEST","The refused request unexpectedly committed.")
                self.state["staleRejection"]={"requestSha256":digest(original_request),"error":error.as_dict()};self.save()
            else:raise Problem("NATIVE_STALE_ACCEPTED","A separate stale write was unexpectedly accepted.")
        current=self.returned("successor-return",following,self.step("successor-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]}))
        verified=self.verify("successor-verification",delta,current)
        row_ids=[r["rowId"] for r in self.rows(self.sender,"plan-rows",{"planId":delta["id"]})]
        undo=self.step("rollback-plan",self.sender,"plan-rollback",{"verificationId":verified["id"],"currentReturnId":current["id"],
            "rowIds":row_ids,"reason":"Restore the original authored target-only notes while preserving all source values and actual native identities."})
        self.apply("rollback-apply",target,undo)
        final_export=self.step("final-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]})
        final_return=self.returned("final-return",following,final_export);self.verify("rollback-verification",undo,final_return)
        restored=self.compare("restored-comparison",initial,final_return,accepted)
        require(restored["counts"]=={"UNCHANGED":10},"NATIVE_RESTORATION","The full original values were not restored.")
        artifacts=[self.export_object("Authored_Original_290.csv",self.sender,original),
                   self.export_object("Complete_Six_Entity_Source.zip",self.sender,published["archive"]),
                   self.export_object("Final_Actual_Local_Target.zip",self.target,final_export["archive"])]
        for name,ref in ready["artifacts"].items():artifacts.append(self.export_object("analysis-"+name+"-"+ref["name"],self.sender,ref))
        source_check=self.sender.verify(True,self.stop);target_check=self.target.verify(True,self.stop)
        if "backupSelection" not in self.state:
            self.state["backupSelection"]={"revision":self.sender.metadata()["revision"],"workspaceId":self.sender.metadata()["id"],
                                          "applicationSha256":self.state["selection"]["applicationSha256"]};self.save()
        selected=self.state["backupSelection"]
        require(selected["workspaceId"]==self.sender.metadata()["id"]
                and selected["applicationSha256"]==self.state["selection"]["applicationSha256"],
                "NATIVE_BACKUP_SELECTION","Retain the original complete backup selection.")
        if "backup" not in self.state:
            self.state["backup"]=backup(self.sender,APPLICATION,revision=selected["revision"],signal=self.stop);self.save()
        archive=self.state["backup"]
        require(Path(archive["path"]).is_file() and not Path(archive["path"]).is_symlink()
                and file_hash(archive["path"],self.stop)==(archive["sha256"],archive["bytes"]),
                "NATIVE_BACKUP","The retained complete original backup differs.")
        received_workspace=receive_archive(archive["path"],self.root/"independent-reopen",archive["sha256"],signal=self.stop)
        cold=Workspace(self.root/"independent-reopen"/"workspace")
        require(cold.metadata()["id"]==self.sender.metadata()["id"] and cold.record("ndtms-analysis",ready["id"])==ready,
                "NATIVE_REOPEN","The complete independent workspace lost its original analysis.")
        result={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-native-result/v1","state":"CORE_COMPLETE","selection":self.state["selection"],
                "sourceWorkspace":str(self.sender.root),"sourceWorkspaceId":self.sender.metadata()["id"],
                "sourceRevision":self.sender.metadata()["revision"],"originalEditionId":ed["id"],"originalTableId":table["id"],
                "sourceCorrectionId":correction["id"],"sourceCorrectionRowId":row["id"],
                "blockedAnalysisId":blocked["id"],"analysisId":ready["id"],
                "normalizedEditionId":normalized["id"],"contractId":contract["id"],"targetId":target["id"],
                "restoredComparison":restored,"artifacts":artifacts,"backup":archive,"received":received_workspace,
                "sourceVerification":source_check,"targetVerification":target_check,
                "renderedStatus":"PENDING: original operator/browser owner must open/use/look at exact application, all reports and attachments at desktop and narrow widths."}
        self.state["result"]=result;self.save();return result

    def browser_inputs(self):
        """Freeze original executable selections and complete outgoing input bytes."""
        root=self.root/"browser-inputs";root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","Use the original ordinary input directory.")
        def identity(path):
            path=Path(path)
            require(path.is_absolute() and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),
                    "NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","Select a complete ordinary absolute input file.",str(path))
            sha,size=file_hash(path,self.stop);return {"path":str(path),"sha256":sha,"bytes":size}
        def publish(path,source,expected):
            if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
                actual=identity(path)
                require(all(actual[k]==expected[k] for k in ("sha256","bytes")),
                        "NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","Preserve the differing retained original input.",str(path));return
            require(source is not None,"NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","The original and retained input are both absent.",str(path))
            fd,temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".ndtms-input-",dir=root)
            try:
                with Path(source).open("rb") as inp,os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as out:
                    while True:
                        check_stop(self.stop);chunk=inp.read(1024*1024)
                        if not chunk:break
                        out.write(chunk)
                    out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
                require(file_hash(temporary,self.stop)==(expected["sha256"],expected["bytes"]),
                        "NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","The selected input changed while being retained.")
                try:os.link(temporary,path)
                except FileExistsError:
                    actual=identity(path);require(all(actual[k]==expected[k] for k in ("sha256","bytes")),
                        "NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","A differing input appeared during publication.")
                directory=os.open(root,os.O_RDONLY)
                try:os.fsync(directory)
                finally:os.close(directory)
            finally:
                try:os.unlink(temporary)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
        runtime={}
        for name in ("node","playwright","chromium"):
            chosen=Path(getattr(self.args,name))
            require(chosen.is_absolute(),"NATIVE_RUNTIME","Use an absolute existing runtime path.",name)
            actual=identity(chosen.resolve(strict=True));runtime[name]={"selectedPath":str(chosen),**actual}
        require(not self.args.attachments or Path(self.args.attachments).is_absolute(),
                "NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","Use an absolute original attachment selection path.")
        manifest_path=str(Path(self.args.attachments).absolute()) if self.args.attachments else None
        archive_path=str(Path(self.args.application_archive).absolute()) if self.args.application_archive else None
        require(not self.args.application_archive or Path(self.args.application_archive).is_absolute(),
                "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","Select the absolute exact outgoing application ZIP.")
        saved=self.state.get("browserInputs")
        if saved is None:
            manifest=None;attachments=[]
            if manifest_path is not None:
                manifest=identity(manifest_path)
                require(manifest["bytes"]<=1024*1024,"NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","The attachment selection exceeds 1 MiB.")
                manifest_raw=Path(manifest_path).read_bytes()
                require((len(manifest_raw),hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest())==(manifest["bytes"],manifest["sha256"]),
                        "NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","The original attachment selection changed while being read.")
                rows=json.loads(manifest_raw.decode("utf-8"))
                require(isinstance(rows,list) and len(rows)<=64,"NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","Select at most 64 complete attachment identities.")
                seen=set()
                for index,row in enumerate(rows):
                    require(isinstance(row,dict) and isinstance(row.get("path"),str),"NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","Use complete path/bytes/sha256 rows.")
                    actual=identity(row["path"])
                    require(actual["path"] not in seen and all(actual[k]==row.get(k) for k in ("bytes","sha256")),
                            "NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","Select each complete exact outgoing file once.",row["path"]);seen.add(actual["path"])
                    target=root/("attachment-"+str(index+1).zfill(2)+"-"+Path(actual["path"]).name)
                    attachments.append({**actual,"originalPath":actual["path"],"path":str(target)})
                manifest={**manifest,"retainedPath":str(root/"Attachment_Selection.json")}
            saved={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-browser-inputs/v1","runtime":runtime,
                   "manifestPath":manifest_path,"manifest":manifest,"applicationArchivePath":archive_path,"attachments":attachments}
            self.state["browserInputs"]=saved;self.save()
        require(saved["runtime"]==runtime and saved["manifestPath"]==manifest_path
                and saved.get("applicationArchivePath")==archive_path,
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_SELECTION","Continue the original runtime and outgoing attachment selection.")
        selected=([{"originalPath":saved["manifest"]["path"],"path":saved["manifest"]["retainedPath"],
                    "sha256":saved["manifest"]["sha256"],"bytes":saved["manifest"]["bytes"]}] if saved["manifest"] else [])+saved["attachments"]
        for row in selected:
            original=Path(row["originalPath"])
            if original.exists() or original.is_symlink():
                actual=identity(original)
                require(all(actual[k]==row[k] for k in ("sha256","bytes")),
                        "NATIVE_BROWSER_INPUT","The original selected input now differs.",str(original))
                source=original
            else:source=None
            publish(Path(row["path"]),source,row)
        if archive_path is not None:
            matches=[row for row in saved["attachments"] if row["originalPath"]==archive_path]
            require(len(matches)==1,"NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","Include the exact application ZIP in the frozen outgoing attachment selection.")
            self.check_application_archive(matches[0])
        return saved


    def check_application_archive(self,selection):
        """Bind the actually running application to every member of its outgoing ZIP."""
        manifest_raw=(APPLICATION/"APPLICATION.json").read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest()==self.state["selection"]["applicationSha256"],
                "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The executing source manifest changed.")
        manifest=json.loads(manifest_raw)
        expected={row["path"]:row for row in manifest["files"]}
        require(len(expected)==len(manifest["files"]) and "APPLICATION.json" not in expected,
                "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The complete selected application manifest repeats a member.")
        expected["APPLICATION.json"]={"sha256":hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(manifest_raw)}
        path=Path(selection["path"])
        require(file_hash(path,self.stop)==(selection["sha256"],selection["bytes"]),
                "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The complete retained outgoing ZIP differs.")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
            members=archive.infolist()
            require(len(members)==len(expected) and len({row.filename for row in members})==len(members)
                    and {row.filename for row in members}==set(expected),
                    "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The outgoing ZIP must contain APPLICATION.json and only its exact complete file inventory at the root.")
            for member in members:
                check_stop(self.stop)
                require(not member.is_dir() and not member.flag_bits&1
                        and ((member.external_attr>>16)&0o170000) in (0,0o100000)
                        and member.file_size==expected[member.filename]["bytes"],
                        "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","An outgoing member differs from its regular complete source selection.",member.filename)
                h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
                with archive.open(member) as inp:
                    while True:
                        check_stop(self.stop);chunk=inp.read(1024*1024)
                        if not chunk:break
                        size+=len(chunk);require(size<=member.file_size,"NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","An outgoing member exceeds its declared size.")
                        h.update(chunk)
                require((h.hexdigest(),size)==(expected[member.filename]["sha256"],expected[member.filename]["bytes"]),
                        "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","An outgoing application member differs from the exact executing source.",member.filename)
        require(file_hash(path,self.stop)==(selection["sha256"],selection["bytes"]),
                "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The selected outgoing ZIP changed while being read.")

    def browser_phase(self,phase,application,workspace,core,source=None):
        inputs=self.browser_inputs();label="ndtms-browser-"+phase
        output=self.output/label;output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        require(output.is_dir() and not output.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_BROWSER_OUTPUT","Use the original browser output directory.")
        process,ready=self.operator(application,workspace,"ndtms-operator-"+phase)
        try:
            require(ready["workspaceId"]==core["sourceWorkspaceId"],"NATIVE_BROWSER_WORKSPACE","The actual listener opened another workspace.")
            config={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-browser-receiving/v1","phase":phase,"operationId":self.args.operation_id,
                    "workspaceId":ready["workspaceId"],"baseUrl":ready["baseUrl"],"sessionUrl":ready["url"],
                    "output":str(output),"playwright":inputs["runtime"]["playwright"]["path"],
                    "chromium":inputs["runtime"]["chromium"]["path"],
                    "receiveName":"original-ndtms-"+digest(self.args.operation_id)[:16],
                    "nativeResult":core,"attachments":[{k:row[k] for k in ("path","bytes","sha256")} for row in inputs["attachments"]]}
            if source is not None:config["sourceBrowserResult"]=source["course"]
            result=self.command([inputs["runtime"]["node"]["path"],str(application/"native/browser.mjs")],label,
                                stdin=(canonical(config)+"\n").encode("utf-8"))
            expected="nelc.ndtms-browser-course/v1" if phase=="source" else "nelc.ndtms-browser-independent/v1"
            require(result.get("schema")=="nelc.ndtms-browser-result/v1" and result.get("status")=="COMPLETE"
                    and result.get("phase")==phase and result.get("course",{}).get("schema")==expected
                    and result["course"].get("state")=="COMPLETE" and result["course"].get("workspaceId")==ready["workspaceId"],
                    "NATIVE_BROWSER_RESULT","The original browser phase did not complete its exact workspace.")
            previous=self.state.setdefault("browser",{}).get(phase)
            require(previous is None or previous==result,"NATIVE_BROWSER_RESULT","Preserve the original complete browser result.")
            self.state["browser"][phase]=result;self.save()
            return result
        finally:self.close_child(process)

    def operate_browser(self):
        # Keep the original frozen core result in the browser selection. Reopening
        # observations contain current descendant heads and must not replace it.
        core=self.state["result"];self.browser_inputs()
        source=self.browser_phase("source",APPLICATION,self.sender.root,core)
        portable=source["course"]["portable"];receipt=portable["receiving"]
        require(receipt.get("schema")=="nelc.receiving-receipt/v1"
                and receipt["archiveSha256"]==portable["backup"]["sha256"]
                and receipt["originalWorkspace"]["id"]==core["sourceWorkspaceId"],
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_RECEIVING","The actual browser returned another archive or workspace.")
        archive=Path(portable["backupPath"])
        require(archive.is_file() and not archive.is_symlink()
                and file_hash(archive,self.stop)==(portable["backup"]["sha256"],portable["backup"]["bytes"]),
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_BACKUP","Retain the full original browser backup.")
        destination=Path(receipt["destination"])
        require(destination.is_absolute() and destination.is_dir() and not destination.is_symlink(),
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_RECEIVING","Use the actual original independent receiving destination.")
        received=receive_archive(archive,destination,receipt["archiveSha256"],signal=self.stop)
        application=destination/"application";workspace=destination/"workspace"
        require(application_files(application,self.stop)[0]==core["selection"]["applicationSha256"],
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_APPLICATION","The independent application differs from the full selected source.")
        independent=self.browser_phase("received",application,workspace,core,source)
        current=Workspace(workspace)
        verification=current.verify(True,self.stop)
        replay=receive_archive(archive,destination,receipt["archiveSha256"],signal=self.stop)
        require(replay["alreadyReceived"] and replay["currentWorkspace"]["revision"]>=receipt["originalWorkspace"]["revision"],
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_REPLAY","The original receiving replay did not preserve recipient history.")
        require(application_files(APPLICATION,self.stop)[0]==core["selection"]["applicationSha256"],
                "NATIVE_BROWSER_APPLICATION","The original application changed during receiving.")
        self.browser_inputs()
        result={"schema":"nelc.ndtms-complete-receiving/v1","state":"RECEIVING_COMPLETE",
                "operationId":self.args.operation_id,"native":core,"browserInputs":self.state["browserInputs"],
                "sourceBrowser":source,"receivedBrowser":independent,"receivingReplay":replay,
                "receivedVerification":verification,"currentSource":self.sender.metadata(),"currentRecipient":current.metadata(),
                "renderedStatus":"BROWSER_COURSE_COMPLETE; producer must personally open and inspect the actual retained images and exact selected outgoing files before declaring their visible presentation ready."}
        self.state["browserResult"]=result;self.save();return result

def main():

    parser.add_argument("--attachments",help="Absolute JSON array of exact outgoing attachment {path,bytes,sha256} identities.")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    selected=[bool(args.node),bool(args.playwright),bool(args.chromium)]
    require(not any(selected) or all(selected),"NATIVE_RUNTIME","Provide --node, --playwright and --chromium together.")
    require(not args.attachments or all(selected),"NATIVE_ATTACHMENTS","Outgoing attachment inspection requires the complete browser runtime selection.")
    require(not args.application_archive or (args.attachments and all(selected)),
            "NATIVE_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE","The exact outgoing application ZIP requires its attachment selection and original browser runtime.")
    stop=threading.Event()
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(sig,lambda *unused:stop.set())
    course=None
    try:
        course=Course(args,stop)
        if all(selected):course.browser_inputs()
        result=course.run()
        if all(selected):result=course.operate_browser()
    finally:
        if course:course.close()
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
if __name__=="__main__":
    try:main()
    except Problem as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error":error.as_dict()}),file=sys.stderr);raise SystemExit(2)
    except (Cancelled,KeyboardInterrupt):raise SystemExit(130)

"""Run this owner's PHP child; Linux also ends it if the Node owner is killed."""
import ctypes
import os
import signal
import sys

if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
    parent = os.getppid()
    if ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True).prctl(1, signal.SIGTERM, 0, 0, 0):
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "Could not bind the PHP child to its owner")
    if parent == 1 or os.getppid() != parent:
        raise SystemExit("The native workspace owner ended before PHP started")
os.execvp(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[1:])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Operate the complete original NHS reporting, local migration and portable handover."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,contextlib,hashlib,json,os,selectors,shutil,signal,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,time,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
APPLICATION=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(APPLICATION))
from nelc.common import Cancelled,Problem,atomic_bytes,canonical,check_stop,digest,file_hash,now,require
from nelc.workspace import Workspace
from nelc.portable import application_files,backup
from receive_workspace import receive_archive
from native.inspect_originals import inspect_originals

class Stop:
    def __init__(self):self.stopped=False
    def is_set(self):return self.stopped
    def set(self):self.stopped=True

class Programme:
    def __init__(self,args,stop):
        self.args=args;self.stop=stop;self.root=Path(args.root).absolute();self.root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        self.path=self.root/"native.json";self.owner=None;self.children=[];self.child_logs=[]
        require(self.root.is_dir() and not self.root.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_ROOT","Use an ordinary owned native directory.")
        owner_path=self.root/"native-owner.sqlite"
        require(not owner_path.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_OWNER_PATH","The original native owner cannot be a symlink.")
        self.owner=sqlite3.connect(owner_path,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
        try:
            try:
                self.owner.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS original_owner(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
                self.owner.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
                raise Problem("NATIVE_IN_USE","The original programme still has an owned native process.") from error
            self.app_sha,self.application_sources=application_files(APPLICATION,stop)
            profile=json.loads((APPLICATION/"source/NHS-2025-26-native-profile.json").read_text("utf-8"))
            original=next(x for x in profile["retained_files"] if x["name"].endswith(".zip"))
            sha,size=file_hash(Path(args.source_zip),stop)
            require((sha,size)==(original["sha256"],original["bytes"]),"ORIGINAL_NHS_ZIP","Use the complete retained original NHS ZIP.")
            workbook_sha,workbook_size=file_hash(Path(args.source_workbook),stop)
            require(workbook_size==1500509,"ORIGINAL_NHS_WORKBOOK","Use the complete retained current annual workbook.")
            binding={"schema":"nelc.native-selection/v1","operationId":args.operation_id,"applicationSha256":self.app_sha,
                     "sourceZip":{"sha256":sha,"bytes":size},"sourceWorkbook":{"sha256":workbook_sha,"bytes":workbook_size},
                     "scope":"Published aggregate E06000012 rows and a separately owned local receiving database."}
            require(not self.path.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_JOURNAL_PATH","The original native journal cannot be a symlink.")
            if self.path.is_file():
                self.state=json.loads(self.path.read_text("utf-8"));require(self.state["selection"]==binding,"NATIVE_SELECTION","Resume the same original source/application/operation.")
            else:
                allowed={"native-owner.sqlite","native-owner.sqlite-journal","native-owner.sqlite-wal","native-owner.sqlite-shm"}
                require(all(p.name in allowed and p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() for p in self.root.iterdir()),
                        "NATIVE_ROOT","Start in a fresh owned native directory or reopen its original journal.")
                self.state={"schema":"nelc.native-receiving/v1","selection":binding,"createdAt":now(),"status":"PREPARED","steps":{},"evidence":{}}
                self.save()
            self.requests=self.root/"requests";self.requests.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            self.output=self.root/"artifacts";self.output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            self.sender=self.open_workspace("operator-workspace","NELC published reporting and migration")
            self.target=self.open_workspace("owned-target-workspace","NELC independent local receiving example")
        except BaseException:
            self.owner.close();self.owner=None
            raise
    def save(self):
        self.state["updatedAt"]=now();atomic_bytes(self.path,(canonical(self.state)+"\n").encode("utf-8"))
    def open_workspace(self,name,title):
        path=self.root/name
        if (path/"workspace.sqlite").is_file():return Workspace(path)
        return Workspace(path,create=True,name=title)
    def request(self,name,workspace,action,data):
        check_stop(self.stop)
        path=self.requests/(name+".request.json")
        if path.exists():
            value=json.loads(path.read_text("utf-8"))
            require(value["action"]==action and value["data"]==data and value["actor"]=={"id":"nelc-native-reviewer","name":"NELC original-source reviewer"},
                    "NATIVE_REQUEST_CHANGED","A retained native step has different action, data or reviewer.",name)
            return value
        value={"requestId":self.args.operation_id+":"+name,"expectedRevision":workspace.metadata()["revision"],
               "actor":{"id":"nelc-native-reviewer","name":"NELC original-source reviewer"},"action":action,"data":data}
        atomic_bytes(path,(canonical(value)+"\n").encode("utf-8"));return value
    def step(self,name,workspace,action,data):
        request=self.request(name,workspace,action,data)
        prior=self.state["steps"].get(name)
        if prior:
            original=workspace.operation(request["requestId"])
            require(original is not None and original["operationId"]==prior["operationId"] and original["result"]==prior["result"],
                    "NATIVE_COMMITTED_STEP","The completed original step is missing or different.",name)
            return prior["result"]
        result=workspace.mutate(request,self.stop)
        self.state["steps"][name]=result;self.save()
        print(canonical({"event":"committed","step":name,"revision":result["revision"],"action":action}),flush=True)
        return result["result"]
    def all_rows(self,workspace,kind,selection):
        offset=0;revision=workspace.metadata()["revision"];rows=[]
        while True:
            check_stop(self.stop);page=workspace.page(kind,selection,revision,offset,200);rows.extend(page["items"])
            if page["nextOffset"] is None:return rows
            offset=page["nextOffset"]
    def transfer_object(self,source,destination,ref):
        with source.connect() as db:path=source.object(db,ref,self.stop)
        with path.open("rb") as stream:copied=destination.put_stream(stream,ref["name"],signal=self.stop)
        require(copied["sha256"]==ref["sha256"] and copied["bytes"]==ref["bytes"],"NATIVE_TRANSFER","The original object changed while transferring.")
        return copied
    def returned(self,name,contract,export):
        archive=self.transfer_object(self.target,self.sender,export["archive"])
        mf=self.transfer_object(self.target,self.sender,export["manifest"])
        edition=self.step(name+"-edition",self.sender,"import-edition",{"name":name+" actual independent target export",
             "object":archive,"source":{"kind":"owned-local-export","manifest":mf,"targetId":export["snapshot"]["targetId"],
                        "snapshotSha256":export["snapshot"]["snapshotSha256"]},
             "csv":{"default":{"encoding":"utf-8-sig","delimiter":",","quotechar":'"'}}})
        tables=[]
        for row in export["snapshot"]["tables"]:
            observed=[x for x in edition["tables"] if x["name"]==row["file"]]
            require(len(observed)==1 and observed[0]["headers"]==row["headers"],"NATIVE_RETURN_HEADERS","The actual returned table differs from its source manifest.")
            tables.append({k:row[k] for k in ("mappingId","fields","identityColumn","versionColumn","dispositionColumn","dispositions")}|
                          {"tableId":observed[0]["id"]})
        result=self.step(name,self.sender,"import-target-return",{"contractId":contract["id"],"editionId":edition["id"],
             "kind":"owned-local-export","basis":"Actual complete export from the independently operated local target, retaining every assigned record ID and version.",
             "completeSnapshot":True,"coverageNote":"Every table and record in the selected owned local target at this export.",
             "tables":tables})
        require(result["ready"] and result["snapshotSha256"]==export["snapshot"]["snapshotSha256"],
                "NATIVE_RETURN_SNAPSHOT","The parsed return must reproduce the actual complete local target snapshot.")
        return result
    def approve(self,name,contract):
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"approve-contract",{"contractId":contract["id"],"definitionSha256":contract["definitionSha256"],
              "sourceReviewed":True,"authorityConfirmed":True,
              "reason":"Reviewed the exact published aggregate source, explicit owned local target columns and complete identity tuples. No supplier system or patient mapping is asserted."})
    def release(self,name,contract):
        self.approve(name+"-approval",contract)
        assessment=self.step(name+"-assessment",self.sender,"assess",{"contractId":contract["id"]})
        require(assessment["ready"] and assessment["mappedRows"]==677,"NATIVE_ASSESSMENT","The complete original 676 service and one finance rows must pass the reviewed aggregate contract.")
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"release",{"contractId":contract["id"],"assessmentId":assessment["id"],
             "name":name+" reviewed aggregate CSV release","reason":"Release exactly the agreed owned-example columns for all 677 selected original aggregate rows."})
    def compare(self,name,release,current,baseline=None):
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"compare-target",{"releaseId":release["id"],"currentReturnId":current["id"],
             "baselineId":baseline["id"] if baseline else None,"name":name,
             "reason":"Compare the complete intended source projection and the actual fresh target export. Preserve unrelated target edits and absent-source records."})
    def plan(self,name,comparison):
        return self.step(name,self.sender,"plan-delta",{"comparisonId":comparison["id"],"allEligible":True,
             "reason":name+" — reviewed every eligible original aggregate row; conflicts are not selected."})
    def apply(self,name,target,plan):
        archive=self.transfer_object(self.sender,self.target,plan["archive"])
        return self.step(name,self.target,"apply-local-plan",{"targetId":target["id"],"archive":archive,"planId":plan["id"],"confirmOwnedLocal":True})
    def verify_return(self,name,plan,current):
        result=self.step(name,self.sender,"verify-plan",{"planId":plan["id"],"returnId":current["id"],
             "reason":"Verify every intended field, retained record identity and explicit per-row disposition from the actual local receiving export."})
        require(result["allFieldsMatched"] and result["allRowsAccepted"],"NATIVE_RETURN_NOT_MATCHED","The actual local return did not verify every planned field and row disposition.")
        return result
    def reject_stale(self,target,plan):
        name="stale-plan-rejection"
        if self.state["evidence"].get(name):return
        archive=self.transfer_object(self.sender,self.target,plan["archive"])
        request=self.request(name,self.target,"apply-local-plan",{"targetId":target["id"],"archive":archive,"planId":plan["id"],"confirmOwnedLocal":True})
        before=self.target.verify(False,self.stop)
        try:self.target.mutate(request,self.stop)
        except Problem as error:
            require(error.code=="TARGET_SNAPSHOT_STALE","NATIVE_STALE_RESULT","The stale plan failed for a different reason.",error.as_dict())
            after=self.target.verify(False,self.stop)
            require(before["workspace"]["revision"]==after["workspace"]["revision"] and before["history"]==after["history"],
                    "NATIVE_STALE_WRITE","A rejected stale plan changed the target event history.")
            self.state["evidence"][name]={"code":error.code,"requestId":request["requestId"],"revision":after["workspace"]["revision"],
                                          "details":error.details,"observedAt":now()};self.save()
        else:raise Problem("NATIVE_STALE_ACCEPTED","A plan based on an older target snapshot was applied.")
    def replay(self,name,workspace):
        request=json.loads((self.requests/(name+".request.json")).read_text("utf-8"))
        before=workspace.metadata()["revision"];result=workspace.mutate(request,self.stop)
        original=self.state["steps"][name]
        require(result["duplicate"] is True and result["operationId"]==original["operationId"]
                and result["result"]==original["result"] and workspace.metadata()["revision"]==before,
                "NATIVE_REQUEST_REPLAY","The original committed request did not return its retained outcome.")
        self.state["evidence"]["replay-"+name]={"requestId":request["requestId"],"operationId":result["operationId"],
                                              "originalRevision":result["revision"],"currentRevision":before,"duplicate":True};self.save()
    def adopt_output(self,target,sha,size):
        require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink() and file_hash(target,self.stop)==(sha,size),
                "NATIVE_OUTPUT_CHANGED","The completed original output differs from its retained selection.",str(target))
        temp=target.with_name(target.name+".receiving")
        if temp.exists() or temp.is_symlink():
            require(temp.is_file() and not temp.is_symlink() and file_hash(temp,self.stop)==(sha,size),
                    "NATIVE_OUTPUT_STAGING","The completed output has an unexpected owned staging file.",str(temp))
            temp.unlink()
            fd=os.open(target.parent,os.O_RDONLY)
            try:os.fsync(fd)
            finally:os.close(fd)
        return target
    def export_object(self,workspace,ref,name):
        target=self.output/name
        with workspace.connect() as db:source=workspace.object(db,ref,self.stop)
        if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
            return self.adopt_output(target,ref["sha256"],ref["bytes"])
        temp=target.with_name(target.name+".receiving")
        require(not temp.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_OUTPUT_PATH","An owned output staging path cannot be a symlink.")
        if temp.exists():temp.unlink()
        with source.open("rb") as inp,temp.open("xb") as out:
            while True:
                check_stop(self.stop);chunk=inp.read(1024*1024)
                if not chunk:break
                out.write(chunk)
            out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
        require(file_hash(temp,self.stop)==(ref["sha256"],ref["bytes"]),"NATIVE_OUTPUT_HASH","The output copy differs from its retained object.")
        os.link(temp,target);temp.unlink();return target
    def core(self):
        inspection_path=self.output/"SOURCE_INSPECTION.json"
        if inspection_path.is_file():
            inspection=json.loads(inspection_path.read_text("utf-8"))
            require(inspection["zip"]["sha256"]==self.state["selection"]["sourceZip"]["sha256"]
                    and inspection["workbook"]["sha256"]==self.state["selection"]["sourceWorkbook"]["sha256"],
                    "NATIVE_SOURCE_INSPECTION","The retained source inspection belongs to other original bytes.")
        else:
            profile=json.loads((APPLICATION/"source/NHS-2025-26-native-profile.json").read_text("utf-8"))
            inspection=inspect_originals(self.args.source_zip,self.args.source_workbook,profile,self.stop)
            atomic_bytes(inspection_path,(canonical(inspection)+"\n").encode())
        self.state["evidence"]["originalSourceInspection"]={"path":"SOURCE_INSPECTION.json","sha256":file_hash(inspection_path,self.stop)[0],
            "sourceWorkbookSha256":inspection["workbook"]["sha256"],"originalNoteSheets":len(inspection["workbook"]["noteRows"])}
        self.save()
        with Path(self.args.source_zip).open("rb") as stream:
            original=self.sender.put_stream(stream,"NHS-original-stop-smoking-2025-26-q4-CSV-pack.zip",signal=self.stop)
        with Path(self.args.source_workbook).open("rb") as stream:
            workbook=self.sender.put_stream(stream,"NHS-original-stop-smoking-2025-26-q4-data-tables.xlsx",signal=self.stop)
        edition=self.step("original-nhs-edition",self.sender,"import-edition",{"name":"Original NHS Stop Smoking Services England 2025–26 Q4 annual",
            "object":original,"source":{"reference":"https://files.digital.nhs.uk/80/83D00C/stat-stop-smok-serv-eng-2025-26-q4.zip",
                "period":{"from":"2025-04-01","to":"2026-03-31"},"publishedAt":"2026-07-23",
                "workbook":workbook,"authorityCode":"E06000012",
                "scope":"Complete published England aggregate edition. Local reporting selects original E06000012 rows."},
            "csv":{"default":{"encoding":"utf-8-sig","delimiter":",","quotechar":'"'}}})
        require(edition["rows"]==110351 and len(edition["tables"])==2,"NATIVE_SOURCE_COUNTS","The full original NHS edition must retain both complete CSV tables.")
        contract=self.step("original-nhs-contract",self.sender,"draft-nhs-contract",{"editionId":edition["id"]})
        first=self.release("original-release",contract)
        target=self.step("open-independent-local-target",self.target,"open-local-target",{
            "name":"NELC independent actual local target","manifest":self.transfer_object(self.sender,self.target,first["manifest"]),
            "archive":self.transfer_object(self.sender,self.target,first["archive"]),"confirmOwnedLocal":True})
        empty_export=self.step("empty-local-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]})
        empty=self.returned("empty-actual-return",contract,empty_export)
        baseline=self.step("accepted-empty-baseline",self.sender,"accept-baseline",{"returnId":empty["id"],"snapshotSha256":empty["snapshotSha256"],
             "reason":"Accept the actual empty independent local target as the commissioning baseline."})
        comparison=self.compare("initial-comparison",first,empty,baseline)
        require(comparison["counts"]=={"CREATE":677},"NATIVE_INITIAL_COMPARISON","The empty target must produce exactly 677 original CREATE instructions.")
        initial_plan=self.plan("initial-plan",comparison)
        initial_receipt=self.apply("initial-actual-apply",target,initial_plan)
        first_export=self.step("initial-local-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]})
        first_return=self.returned("initial-actual-return",contract,first_export)
        first_verification=self.verify_return("initial-return-verification",initial_plan,first_return)
        accepted=self.step("accepted-initial-baseline",self.sender,"accept-baseline",{"returnId":first_return["id"],
            "snapshotSha256":first_return["snapshotSha256"],"reason":"The actual independent local return matches every original aggregate field and reports acceptance for all 677 rows."})
        definition=json.loads(canonical(contract["definition"]));definition["name"]="Reviewed receiving note revision for the same original aggregate source"
        for mapping in definition["tables"]:
            note=next(c for c in mapping["target"]["columns"] if c["name"]=="Migration review note")
            note["constant"]="Reviewed original aggregate receiving"
        revised=self.step("reviewed-note-contract",self.sender,"save-contract",{"definition":definition,"supersedes":contract["id"],
            "reason":"Change only the target-only Migration review note to demonstrate the reviewed delta. Every original clinical/aggregate source string stays unchanged."})
        require(revised["targetSignature"]==contract["targetSignature"],"NATIVE_TARGET_CONTRACT","The note source projection must retain the same agreed target schema.")
        following=self.release("reviewed-note-release",revised)
        delta_comparison=self.compare("reviewed-note-comparison",following,first_return,accepted)
        require(delta_comparison["counts"]=={"UPDATE":677},"NATIVE_DELTA_COMPARISON","The reviewed note revision must update exactly 677 existing target records.")
        delta=self.plan("reviewed-note-plan",delta_comparison)
        stale=self.plan("separately-reviewed-stale-plan",delta_comparison)
        delta_receipt=self.apply("reviewed-note-actual-apply",target,delta)
        self.reject_stale(target,stale)
        delta_export=self.step("reviewed-note-local-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]})
        delta_return=self.returned("reviewed-note-actual-return",revised,delta_export)
        delta_verification=self.verify_return("reviewed-note-verification",delta,delta_return)
        row_ids=[r["rowId"] for r in self.all_rows(self.sender,"plan-rows",{"planId":delta["id"]})]
        rollback=self.step("reviewed-note-rollback",self.sender,"plan-rollback",{"verificationId":delta_verification["id"],
            "currentReturnId":delta_return["id"],"rowIds":row_ids,
            "reason":"Restore the original target-only review-note beforeimage after the verified delta, preserving every record identity and all source clinical values."})
        rollback_receipt=self.apply("reviewed-note-rollback-apply",target,rollback)
        final_export=self.step("rollback-local-export",self.target,"export-local-target",{"targetId":target["id"]})
        final_return=self.returned("rollback-actual-return",revised,final_export)
        rollback_verification=self.verify_return("rollback-return-verification",rollback,final_return)
        restored=self.compare("restored-original-comparison",first,final_return,accepted)
        require(restored["counts"]=={"UNCHANGED":677},"NATIVE_ROLLBACK_RESTORATION","The actual rollback must restore every original released field.")
        service=next(t for t in edition["tables"] if "finance" not in t["name"])
        source_rows=self.all_rows(self.sender,"source-rows",{"editionId":edition["id"],"tableId":service["id"],
                   "filters":[{"column":service["headers"].index("OrgCode"),"value":"E06000012"}]})
        quarter_index=service["headers"].index("Quarter")
        quarters=sorted({row["values"][quarter_index] for row in source_rows})
        require(quarters==["1","2","3","4"],"NATIVE_QUARTERS","The selected original edition must retain the four actual quarter labels.")
        reports={}
        for quarter in quarters:
            reports[quarter]=self.step("report-quarter-"+quarter,self.sender,"nhs-report",{"editionId":edition["id"],"table":"service",
                  "quarter":quarter,"name":"NELC original published quarter "+quarter+" — All persons / Age band / All ages"})
        finance=self.step("report-finance",self.sender,"nhs-report",{"editionId":edition["id"],"table":"finance","name":"NELC original annual finance values"})
        comparisons=[]
        for a,b in (("1","2"),("3","4")):
            keys=[h for h in reports[a]["dimensionHeaders"] if h!="Quarter"]
            result=self.step("report-compare-"+a+"-"+b,self.sender,"compare-reports",{"firstReportId":reports[a]["id"],"secondReportId":reports[b]["id"],
                "keyHeaders":keys,"metricHeaders":["Set quit date","Quit","Quit (%)"],
                "reason":"Compare the two explicitly selected published quarter rows with the same non-quarter dimensions. This is a source-value comparison, without summing overlapping populations or inferring cohort or annual change."})
            require(result["complete"],"NATIVE_REPORT_COMPLETENESS","The original selected report population must be complete.")
            comparisons.append(result)
        self.replay("original-nhs-edition",self.sender);self.replay("initial-actual-apply",self.target);self.replay("reviewed-note-rollback-apply",self.target)
        self.state["evidence"]["core"]={"editionId":edition["id"],"contractId":contract["id"],"revisedContractId":revised["id"],
            "originalRows":edition["rows"],"selectedRows":677,"sourceZipSha256":original["sha256"],"sourceWorkbookSha256":workbook["sha256"],
            "releaseIds":[first["id"],following["id"]],"targetId":target["id"],
            "planIds":[initial_plan["id"],delta["id"],rollback["id"]],
            "localReceiptIds":[initial_receipt["receipt"]["id"],delta_receipt["receipt"]["id"],rollback_receipt["receipt"]["id"]],
            "verificationIds":[first_verification["id"],delta_verification["id"],rollback_verification["id"]],
            "finalReturnId":final_return["id"],"restoredComparisonId":restored["id"],"reportIds":{q:r["id"] for q,r in reports.items()},
            "financeReportId":finance["id"],"reportComparisonIds":[r["id"] for r in comparisons],
            "scope":"Actual published aggregate source and independently operated local receiving, with explicit local row dispositions; no supplier or patient-record acceptance is claimed."}
        for name,ws,ref in [
            ("Original_NHS_2025_26.zip",self.sender,original),("Original_NHS_Annual_Workbook.xlsx",self.sender,workbook),
            ("Reviewed_Initial_CSV_Release.zip",self.sender,first["archive"]),("RELEASE.json",self.sender,first["manifest"]),
            ("Reviewed_Note_Delta.zip",self.sender,delta["archive"]),("Verified_Note_Rollback.zip",self.sender,rollback["archive"]),
            ("Final_Actual_Local_Target.zip",self.target,final_export["archive"]),("TARGET-RETURN.json",self.target,final_export["manifest"]),
            ("Quarter_1_2_Comparison.csv",self.sender,comparisons[0]["artifact"]),("Quarter_3_4_Comparison.csv",self.sender,comparisons[1]["artifact"]),
            ("Annual_Finance.csv",self.sender,finance["artifact"])]:
            self.export_object(ws,ref,name)
        self.state["evidence"]["sourceVerification"]=self.sender.verify(True,self.stop)
        self.state["evidence"]["targetVerification"]=self.target.verify(True,self.stop)
        self.state["status"]="CORE_COMPLETE";self.save()
        return self.state["evidence"]["core"]
    def owned_process(self,argv,label,stdin=None):
        check_stop(self.stop);log_path=self.root/(label+".stderr.log");log=log_path.open("ab")
        process=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(APPLICATION/"native/parent_death.py"),*map(str,argv)],
             cwd=self.root,stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
             stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log,shell=False)
        self.children.append(process);self.child_logs.append(log)
        if stdin is not None:
            try:process.stdin.write(stdin);process.stdin.close()
            except BaseException:self.close_child(process);raise

    def close_child(self,process):
        if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()

        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill();process.wait();raise Problem("NATIVE_CHILD_CLOSE","An owned child did not finish its maintained closure within 45 seconds.")
        if process.stdout and not process.stdout.closed:process.stdout.close()

        process=self.owned_process(argv,label,stdin);selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();selector.register(process.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
        body=bytearray();limit=16*1024*1024

                    body.extend(chunk);require(len(body)<=limit,"NATIVE_CHILD_OUTPUT","The child result exceeds 16 MiB.")
            code=process.wait();require(code==0,"NATIVE_CHILD_FAILED","The original owned child did not complete.",{"label":label,"exitCode":code,"stderr":str(self.root/(label+".stderr.log"))})
            try:return json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
            except (UnicodeError,ValueError) as error:raise Problem("NATIVE_CHILD_RESULT","The original child did not return one complete JSON result.",label) from error
        finally:selector.close();self.close_child(process)
    def operator(self,application,workspace,label):
        process=self.owned_process([sys.executable,str(application/"operator/server.py"),"--workspace",str(workspace)],label)
        selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();selector.register(process.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
        pending=bytearray();deadline=time.monotonic()+60
        try:
            while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                check_stop(self.stop)
                for key,_ in selector.select(.2):
                    chunk=os.read(key.fd,65536)
                    require(chunk,"OPERATOR_START","The original operator ended before its ready response.")
                    pending.extend(chunk);require(len(pending)<65536,"OPERATOR_START","The operator ready response is too large.")
                    if b"\n" in pending:
                        ready=json.loads(pending.split(b"\n",1)[0]);require(ready.get("schema")=="nelc.operator-ready/v1","OPERATOR_READY","The listener returned a different contract.")
                        return process,ready
                require(process.poll() is None,"OPERATOR_START","The owned local operator ended before readiness.")
            raise Problem("OPERATOR_TIMEOUT","The original operator did not report readiness.")
        except BaseException:self.close_child(process);raise
        finally:selector.close()
    def browser(self,phase,application,workspace,core):
        label="browser-"+phase;output=self.output/label;output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        process,ready=self.operator(application,workspace,"operator-"+phase)
        try:
            config={"schema":"nelc.browser-receiving/v1","phase":phase,"operationId":self.args.operation_id,
                "baseUrl":ready["baseUrl"],"sessionUrl":ready["url"],"workspaceId":ready["workspaceId"],
                "output":str(output),"chromium":self.args.chromium,"playwright":self.args.playwright,
                "editionId":core["editionId"],"contractId":core["contractId"],"reportId":core["reportIds"]["4"],
                "quarter":"4","receiveName":"original-nelc-"+digest(self.args.operation_id)[:16]}
            result=self.command([self.args.node,str(application/"native/browser.mjs")],label,stdin=(canonical(config)+"\n").encode())
            require(result["workspaceId"]==ready["workspaceId"] and result["status"]=="COMPLETE","NATIVE_BROWSER_RESULT","The browser did not complete this original workspace.")
            return result
        finally:self.close_child(process)
    def portable(self,core):
        source=self.browser("source",APPLICATION,self.sender.root,core)
        self.state["evidence"]["sourceBrowser"]=source;self.save()
        destination=Path(source["receiving"]["destination"])
        require(destination.is_dir() and not destination.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_RECEIVED_PATH","The actual operator receiving directory is unavailable.")
        app=destination/"application";workspace=destination/"workspace"
        require(application_files(app,self.stop)[0]==self.app_sha,"NATIVE_DELIVERED_APPLICATION","The delivered application differs from the frozen complete source.")
        verify=self.command([sys.executable,str(app/"cli.py"),"--workspace",str(workspace),"verify"],"delivered-cli-verify")
        require(verify.get("complete") is True,"NATIVE_DELIVERED_VERIFY","The delivered CLI did not verify the full source and history.")
        received=self.browser("received",app,workspace,core)
        self.state["evidence"]["receivedBrowser"]=received;self.state["evidence"]["receivedCliVerification"]=verify;self.save()
        # Reconcile the original receive after a legitimate new operation on that received workspace.
        archive=Path(source["backupPath"])
        repeated=receive_archive(archive,destination,source["backup"]["sha256"],signal=self.stop)
        require(repeated["alreadyReceived"] and repeated["currentWorkspace"]["revision"]>=repeated["originalWorkspace"]["revision"],
                "NATIVE_RECEIVING_REPLAY","Receiving replay did not preserve the already-operated recipient.")
        self.state["evidence"]["receivingReplay"]=repeated
        final_backup=self.command([sys.executable,str(app/"cli.py"),"--workspace",str(workspace),"backup"],"delivered-cli-backup")
        local_backup=backup(self.target,APPLICATION,signal=self.stop)
        for name,receipt in (("NELC_Complete_Reporting_Workspace.zip",final_backup),("NELC_Independent_Local_Target.zip",local_backup)):
            source_path=Path(receipt["path"]);target=self.output/name
            require(file_hash(source_path,self.stop)==(receipt["sha256"],receipt["bytes"]),"NATIVE_BACKUP_RECEIPT","The frozen source backup differs from its complete receipt.")
            if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():self.adopt_output(target,receipt["sha256"],receipt["bytes"])
            else:
                temp=target.with_name(target.name+".receiving")
                if temp.exists():require(temp.is_file() and not temp.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_FINAL_PATH","Only an owned ordinary staging file can be recovered.");temp.unlink()
                with source_path.open("rb") as inp,temp.open("xb") as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(inp,out,1024*1024);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
                os.link(temp,target);temp.unlink()
            atomic_bytes(self.output/(name+".receipt.json"),(canonical(receipt)+"\n").encode())
        self.state["evidence"]["finalBackups"]={"reporting":final_backup,"localTarget":local_backup}
        self.state["status"]="RECEIVING_COMPLETE";self.save()
    def package(self):
        selection=self.state["selection"];target=self.root/"NELC_Reporting_Migration_Complete.zip"
        if target.is_file():
            with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as archive:
                manifest=json.loads(archive.read("MANIFEST.json"));require(manifest["selection"]==selection,"NATIVE_PACKAGE_SELECTION","The completed package has a different original selection.")
                require(set(archive.namelist())=={"MANIFEST.json"}|{x["path"] for x in manifest["files"]},"NATIVE_PACKAGE_MEMBERS","The completed package has unexpected or missing members.")
                for item in manifest["files"]:
                    check_stop(self.stop);h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
                    with archive.open(item["path"]) as stream:
                        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b""):check_stop(self.stop);h.update(chunk);count+=len(chunk)
                    require((h.hexdigest(),count)==(item["sha256"],item["bytes"]),"NATIVE_PACKAGE_HASH","The retained complete package differs from its exact files.")
        else:
            report={"schema":"nelc.complete-receiving-report/v1","selection":selection,"evidence":self.state["evidence"],
                "status":"COMPLETE","completedAt":now(),
                "limits":"The original source is published aggregate NHS reporting. Local target IDs, versions, transactions and dispositions are actual owned-example outcomes. The supplier's patient export schema, clinical rules and actual receiving approval remain supplied commercial inputs."}
            atomic_bytes(self.output/"RECEIVING_REPORT.json",(canonical(report)+"\n").encode())
            guide=("NELC reporting and migration — complete original receiving\n\n"
                "Read artifacts/RECEIVING_REPORT.json and its exact original input/source identities first.\n"
                "The two complete portable ZIPs contain the source application and full SQLite/object history.\n"
                "Use RECEIVE.py from either ZIP with the accompanying SHA256 receipt to receive each into its own fresh directory.\n"
                "Run: python3 application/operator/server.py --workspace workspace\n"
                "The reporting workspace retains all 110,351 published source rows and reviewed 677-row NELC migration.\n"
                "The separate local target retains actual assigned IDs and versions after initial apply, note delta and verified rollback.\n"
                "Quarter comparisons retain original populations and values; no overlapping totals are added.\n"
                "The vendor-facing mapping remains explicit and must use supplied schemas and actual returned acceptance.\n").encode()
            atomic_bytes(self.output/"OPEN.txt",guide)
            members=[]
            for base,prefix in ((self.output,"artifacts"),(self.requests,"requests")):
                for path in sorted(base.rglob("*")):
                    check_stop(self.stop)
                    if path.is_file():
                        require(not path.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_PACKAGE_PATH","A package source cannot be a symlink.")
                        require(not path.name.endswith(".receiving"),"NATIVE_PACKAGE_PARTIAL","An original output remains incomplete.",str(path))
                        members.append((prefix+"/"+path.relative_to(base).as_posix(),path))
            manifest={"schema":"nelc.complete-case/v1","selection":selection,"files":[{"path":name,"sha256":file_hash(path,self.stop)[0],"bytes":path.stat().st_size} for name,path in members],
                      "createdAt":report["completedAt"]}
            temp=target.with_name(target.name+".receiving")
            if temp.exists():require(temp.is_file() and not temp.is_symlink(),"NATIVE_PACKAGE_PATH","The owned package staging path must be ordinary.");temp.unlink()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(temp,"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as archive:
                for name,path in members:check_stop(self.stop);archive.write(path,name)
                archive.writestr("MANIFEST.json",canonical(manifest))
            with temp.open("rb") as stream:os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.link(temp,target);temp.unlink()
            return self.package()
        sha,size=file_hash(target,self.stop)
        self.adopt_output(target,sha,size)
        result={"schema":"nelc.complete-native-result/v1","operationId":self.args.operation_id,"status":"COMPLETE",
                "selection":selection,"archive":{"path":str(target),"sha256":sha,"bytes":size},"report":str(self.output/"RECEIVING_REPORT.json"),
                "sourceWorkspace":str(self.sender.root),"localTargetWorkspace":str(self.target.root),
                "receivedWorkspace":str(Path(self.state["evidence"]["sourceBrowser"]["receiving"]["destination"])/"workspace"),
                "originalSourceRows":110351,"selectedAggregateRows":677,"actualTargetTransactions":3,
                "reportComparisons":2,"supplierAcceptanceObserved":False}
        self.state["result"]=result;self.state["status"]="COMPLETE";self.save()
        atomic_bytes(self.root/"RESULT.json",(canonical(result)+"\n").encode());return result
    def close(self):
        errors=[]
        for process in reversed(self.children):
            try:self.close_child(process)
            except BaseException as error:errors.append(str(error))
        for stream in self.child_logs:
            if not stream.closed:stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno());stream.close()
        if self.owner is not None:self.owner.close()
        if errors:raise Problem("NATIVE_CLOSE","An owned child required attention during closure.",errors)
    def run(self):
        if self.state["status"]=="COMPLETE":return self.package()
        core=self.core();self.portable(core);return self.package()

def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ("root","operation-id","source-zip","source-workbook","node","playwright","chromium"):parser.add_argument("--"+name,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args(argv);stop=Stop();programme=None
    prior={sig:signal.signal(sig,lambda *unused:stop.set()) for sig in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM)}
    try:
        for path in (args.source_zip,args.source_workbook,args.node,args.playwright,args.chromium):
            require(Path(path).is_file(),"NATIVE_INPUT_MISSING","The complete programme requires an existing original input/runtime file.",str(path))
        programme=Programme(args,stop)
        try:result=programme.run()
        except BaseException as error:
            programme.state["status"]="INTERRUPTED" if isinstance(error,Cancelled) or stop.is_set() else "ATTENTION"
            programme.state["failure"]={"code":error.code if isinstance(error,Problem) else type(error).__name__,"message":str(error),"observedAt":now()}
            programme.save();raise

    except Cancelled:
        print(json.dumps({"status":"INTERRUPTED","operationId":args.operation_id,"error":"NATIVE_CANCELLED"}));return 130
    except Problem as error:
        print(json.dumps({"status":"ATTENTION","operationId":args.operation_id,"error":error.as_dict()},ensure_ascii=False),file=sys.stderr);return 1
    finally:
        if programme is not None:programme.close()
        for sig,value in prior.items():signal.signal(sig,value)
    return 0

from __future__ import annotations
import csv, hashlib, io, json, stat, zipfile
from .common import *

def _table(store, db, edition_id, ref, name, options, signal):
    encoding=options.get("encoding","utf-8-sig")
    require(encoding in ("utf-8-sig","utf-8","utf-16","cp1252"),"ENCODING","Select an explicitly supported source encoding.")
    delimiter=options.get("delimiter",","); quote=options.get("quotechar",'"')
    require(isinstance(delimiter,str) and len(delimiter)==1 and delimiter not in "\r\n\x00"
            and isinstance(quote,str) and len(quote)==1 and quote not in "\r\n\x00" and delimiter!=quote,
            "CSV_DIALECT","Declare one distinct delimiter and quote character.")
    table_id="table-"+digest({"edition":edition_id,"object":ref["sha256"],"name":name})[:24]
    path=store.object(db,ref,signal)
    count,width_errors=0,0; widths={}; samples=[]; headers=None
    csv.field_size_limit(MAX_CELL_BYTES)
    try:
        with path.open("r",encoding=encoding,newline="") as stream:
            reader=csv.reader(stream,delimiter=delimiter,quotechar=quote,strict=True)
            try: headers=next(reader)
            except StopIteration: raise Problem("CSV_EMPTY","The source CSV has no header.",name)
            require(1<=len(headers)<=5000,"CSV_HEADERS","The source header is empty or exceeds 5,000 columns.",name)
            for ordinal,cells in enumerate(reader,start=2):
                check_stop(signal)
                count+=1; require(count<=MAX_ROWS,"ROW_LIMIT","An edition is limited to 250,000 operational rows.")
                require(all(len(cell.encode("utf-8"))<=MAX_CELL_BYTES for cell in cells),"CELL_LIMIT","A source cell exceeds 2 MiB.")
                width=len(cells); widths[str(width)]=widths.get(str(width),0)+1
                if width!=len(headers):
                    width_errors+=1
                    if len(samples)<20: samples.append({"sourceRow":ordinal,"columns":width})
                row_id="row-"+digest({"table":table_id,"sourceRow":ordinal})[:28]
                proof=digest({"sourceSha256":ref["sha256"],"sourceRow":ordinal,"values":cells})
                db.execute("INSERT INTO rows VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",(edition_id,table_id,ordinal,row_id,canonical(cells),width,proof))
    except (UnicodeError,csv.Error) as error:
        raise Problem("CSV_PARSE","The original CSV cannot be read with the declared encoding/dialect.",
                      {"file":name,"reason":str(error)})
    duplicates=sorted({h for h in headers if headers.count(h)>1})
    return {"id":table_id,"name":name,"object":ref,"headers":headers,"rows":count,"encoding":encoding,
            "dialect":{"delimiter":delimiter,"quotechar":quote},"widthCounts":widths,"widthErrorCount":width_errors,
            "widthErrorExamples":samples,"duplicateHeaderNames":duplicates,
            "rowNumberMeaning":"One-based CSV record number including the header; embedded newlines remain within a record."}

def import_edition(store,db,data,ctx):
    name=text(data.get("name"),"edition name",maximum=300)
    ref=data.get("object"); original=store.object(db,ref,ctx["signal"])
    source=data.get("source",{})
    require(isinstance(source,dict),"SOURCE_METADATA","Source metadata must be an object.")
    options=data.get("csv",{})
    require(isinstance(options,dict),"CSV_OPTIONS","CSV options must be an object.")
    edition_basis={"object":ref["sha256"],"source":source,"csv":options,"name":name}
    edition_id="edition-"+digest(edition_basis)[:28]
    prior=db.execute("SELECT data_json FROM records WHERE kind='edition' AND id=?",(edition_id,)).fetchone()
    if prior: return {**json.loads(prior[0]),"id":edition_id}
    files=[]; members=[]
    if zipfile.is_zipfile(original):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as archive:
            infos=archive.infolist()
            require(len(infos)<=1000,"ARCHIVE_MEMBERS","The source archive exceeds 1,000 members.")
            names=set(); expanded=0
            for item in infos:
                check_stop(ctx["signal"])
                if item.is_dir(): continue
                safe_relative(item.filename)
                require(item.filename not in names,"ARCHIVE_DUPLICATE","An original archive repeats a member name.",item.filename)
                names.add(item.filename)
                mode=(item.external_attr>>16)&0xFFFF
                require(not stat.S_ISLNK(mode) and (not stat.S_IFMT(mode) or stat.S_ISREG(mode)),
                        "ARCHIVE_MEMBER_TYPE","Only ordinary source files are supported.",item.filename)
                expanded+=item.file_size
                require(item.file_size<=MAX_MEMBER_BYTES and expanded<=MAX_INPUT_BYTES,
                        "ARCHIVE_SIZE","The source archive exceeds its declared expanded size.")
                with archive.open(item) as body:
                    obj=store.put_stream(body,item.filename.rsplit("/",1)[-1],MAX_MEMBER_BYTES,ctx["signal"],db=db)
                require(obj["bytes"]==item.file_size,"ARCHIVE_LENGTH","An original member ended early.")
                members.append({"path":item.filename,"object":obj,"crc32":f"{item.CRC:08x}"})
                if item.filename.lower().endswith((".csv",".tsv")):
                    require(len(files)<MAX_TABLES,"TABLE_LIMIT","An edition is limited to 20 source CSV tables.")
                    csv_options=options.get(item.filename,options.get("default",{}))
                    if item.filename.lower().endswith(".tsv") and "delimiter" not in csv_options:
                        csv_options={**csv_options,"delimiter":"\t"}
                    files.append(_table(store,db,edition_id,obj,item.filename,csv_options,ctx["signal"]))
    else:
        csv_options=options.get("default",options)
        files.append(_table(store,db,edition_id,ref,ref.get("name","source.csv"),csv_options,ctx["signal"]))
    require(files,"NO_CSV","The retained input contains no CSV or TSV tables.")
    require(sum(t["rows"] for t in files)<=MAX_ROWS,"ROW_LIMIT","An edition is limited to 250,000 operational rows in total.")
    value={"schema":"nelc.edition/v1","name":name,"original":ref,"source":source,"csvOptions":options,
           "tables":files,"members":members,"rows":sum(t["rows"] for t in files),
           "createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"],
           "custody":"Original bytes retained unchanged; parsed cells retain source strings and record ordinals."}
    db.execute("INSERT INTO records VALUES(?,?,?,?)",("edition",edition_id,canonical(value),ctx["revision"]))
    return {**value,"id":edition_id}

def table_in(edition,table_id):
    found=[t for t in edition["tables"] if t["id"]==table_id]
    require(len(found)==1,"TABLE_MISSING","Select a table from the exact source edition.")
    return found[0]

def row_page(store,db,edition_id,table_id,offset=0,limit=50,filters=None,signal=None):
    edition=store.get(db,"edition",edition_id); table=table_in(edition,table_id)
    integer(offset,"offset"); integer(limit,"limit",1,200)
    clauses=["edition_id=?","table_id=?"]; params=[edition_id,table_id]
    for item in filters or []:
        index=column(item.get("column"),table["headers"])
        value=text(item.get("value"),"filter value",nonempty=False)
        clauses.append("json_extract(cells_json, ?) = ?"); params.extend([f"$[{index}]",value])
    where=" AND ".join(clauses)
    total=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM rows WHERE "+where,params).fetchone()[0]
    rows=db.execute("SELECT * FROM rows WHERE "+where+" ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",params+[limit,offset]).fetchall()
    corrections=store.corrections(db,edition_id,table_id)
    return {"editionId":edition_id,"table":table,"total":total,"offset":offset,
            "nextOffset":offset+len(rows) if offset+len(rows)<total else None,
            "items":[{"id":r["row_id"],"sourceRow":r["ordinal"],"values":json.loads(r["cells_json"]),
                      "effectiveValues":store.effective_cells(r,corrections),"sha256":r["sha256"],
                      "width":r["width"],"corrections":[c for (tid,rid,idx),c in corrections.items() if rid==r["row_id"]]} for r in rows]}

def correct(store,db,data,ctx):
    edition=store.get(db,"edition",data.get("editionId")); table=table_in(edition,data.get("tableId"))
    index=column(data.get("column"),table["headers"])
    row=db.execute("SELECT * FROM rows WHERE edition_id=? AND table_id=? AND row_id=?",
                   (edition["id"],table["id"],data.get("rowId"))).fetchone()
    require(row is not None and index<row["width"],"SOURCE_ROW","Select an existing source cell.")
    corrections=store.corrections(db,edition["id"],table["id"])
    previous=corrections.get((table["id"],row["row_id"],index))
    current=store.effective_cells(row,corrections)[index]
    require(data.get("from")==current and data.get("supersedes")== (previous["id"] if previous else None),
            "CORRECTION_STALE","The reviewed cell or its previous correction has changed.",
            {"current":current,"supersedes":previous["id"] if previous else None})
    value=text(data.get("to"),"corrected value",nonempty=False,maximum=MAX_CELL_BYTES)
    reason=text(data.get("reason"),"correction reason")
    basis=data.get("basis",{})
    require(isinstance(basis,dict) and bool(basis),"CORRECTION_BASIS","Retain the supplied evidence for this correction.")
    return store.put(db,"correction",{"editionId":edition["id"],"tableId":table["id"],"rowId":row["row_id"],
        "sourceRow":row["ordinal"],"column":index,"header":table["headers"][index],"original":json.loads(row["cells_json"])[index],
        "from":current,"to":value,"supersedes":previous["id"] if previous else None,"basis":basis,"reason":reason,
        "actor":ctx["actor"],"createdAt":ctx["at"]},ctx["revision"])

from __future__ import annotations
import csv, hashlib, io, json, os, tempfile, uuid, zipfile
from .common import *
from .releases import load_release,zip_objects
from .migration import snapshot_digest

RESERVED=("_local_record_id","_local_version","_local_disposition")

def local_snapshot(db,target):
    iterator=((r["mapping_id"],r["target_key"],r["record_id"],str(r["version"]),json.loads(r["cells_json"]))
              for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM local_rows WHERE target_id=? ORDER BY mapping_id,target_key",(target["id"],)))
    return snapshot_digest(target["targetSignature"],iterator)

def open_target(store,db,data,ctx):
    manifest,path=load_release(store,db,data.get("manifest"),data.get("archive"),ctx["signal"])
    for t in manifest["tables"]:
        require(not set(t["headers"])&set(RESERVED),"LOCAL_RESERVED_HEADERS",
                "The owned example's identity columns conflict with this target contract.")
    require(data.get("confirmOwnedLocal") is True,"LOCAL_TARGET_SCOPE",
            "Confirm that this is an owned local receiving database, separate from a supplier system.")
    return store.put(db,"local-target",{"name":text(data.get("name"),"local receiving name",maximum=300),
        "targetSignature":manifest["targetSignature"],"tables":manifest["tables"],
        "relationships":manifest.get("relationships",[]),"sourceManifest":data["manifest"],"sourceArchive":data["archive"],
        "createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"],"initialState":"Empty owned local target.",
        "scope":"This actual local receiving database demonstrates the contract. It does not represent an installed vendor system or supplier acceptance."},ctx["revision"])

def export_target(store,db,data,ctx):
    target=store.get(db,"local-target",data.get("targetId"));tables=[];files=[]
    snapshot=local_snapshot(db,target)
    for table in target["tables"]:
        fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".return-",dir=store.root);count=0
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as stream:
                writer=csv.writer(stream,lineterminator="\r\n");writer.writerow([*table["headers"],*RESERVED])

                    check_stop(ctx["signal"]);count+=1
                    writer.writerow([*json.loads(row["cells_json"]),row["record_id"],str(row["version"]),"accepted"])
                stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
