def _relations(db,target,signal):
    mappings={m["id"]:m for m in target["tables"]}
    db.execute("CREATE TEMP TABLE local_relation_keys(side TEXT,key TEXT)")
    db.execute("CREATE INDEX temp.local_relation_index ON local_relation_keys(side,key)")
    for rel in target["relationships"]:
        db.execute("DELETE FROM local_relation_keys")
        for side,mid,fields in (("parent",rel["toTable"],rel["toFields"]),("child",rel["fromTable"],rel["fromFields"])):
            indices=[mappings[mid]["headers"].index(x) for x in fields]
            for row in db.execute("SELECT cells_json FROM local_rows WHERE target_id=? AND mapping_id=?",(target["id"],mid)):
                check_stop(signal);cells=json.loads(row[0]);values=[cells[i] for i in indices]
                if any(v=="" for v in values):
                    require(side=="child" and not rel["required"],"LOCAL_RELATIONSHIP_EMPTY","A resulting required relationship is empty.",rel["id"])
                    continue
                db.execute("INSERT INTO local_relation_keys VALUES(?,?)",(side,key(values)))
        require(db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM local_relation_keys WHERE side='parent' GROUP BY key HAVING count(*)>1 LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None,
                "LOCAL_PARENT_COLLISION","The resulting parent identity is ambiguous.",rel["id"])
        require(db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM local_relation_keys c WHERE side='child' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_relation_keys p WHERE p.side='parent' AND p.key=c.key) LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None,
                "LOCAL_PARENT_MISSING","The change would leave an unresolved relationship.",rel["id"])
        if rel["cardinality"]=="one-to-one":
            require(db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM local_relation_keys WHERE side='child' GROUP BY key HAVING count(*)>1 LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None,
                    "LOCAL_CARDINALITY","The resulting relationship violates its reviewed one-to-one rule.",rel["id"])
    db.execute("DROP TABLE local_relation_keys")

def apply_plan(store,db,data,ctx):
    target=store.get(db,"local-target",data.get("targetId"));archive_path=store.object(db,data.get("archive"),ctx["signal"])
    require(data.get("confirmOwnedLocal") is True,"LOCAL_TARGET_SCOPE","Confirm the owned local target before applying this reviewed plan.")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        require(len(archive.infolist())==2 and set(archive.namelist())=={"PLAN.json","operations.ndjson"},"PLAN_ARCHIVE","The plan archive has unexpected members.")
        require(archive.getinfo("PLAN.json").file_size<=1024*1024,"PLAN_MANIFEST_SIZE","The plan manifest is too large.")
        manifest=json.loads(archive.read("PLAN.json").decode("utf-8"))
        require(manifest.get("schema")=="nelc.delta-plan/v1" and manifest.get("kind") in ("delta","rollback"),
                "PLAN_SCHEMA","Select a complete reviewed change plan.")
        require(manifest["targetSignature"]==target["targetSignature"],"LOCAL_TARGET_CONTRACT","The plan targets a different contract.")
        require(data.get("planId")==manifest.get("planId"),"PLAN_ID","The selected plan ID differs from its exact archive.")
        existing=[]
        for row in db.execute("SELECT id,data_json FROM records WHERE kind='local-receipt' ORDER BY created_revision"):
            r={**json.loads(row["data_json"]),"id":row["id"]}
            if r["targetId"]==target["id"] and r["planId"]==manifest["planId"]:existing.append(r)
        if existing:
            require(existing[-1]["archive"]["sha256"]==data["archive"]["sha256"],"PLAN_CHANGED","A previously applied plan has different bytes.")
            return {"receipt":existing[-1],"replayedPlan":True}
        source_tables={t["id"]:t for t in target["tables"]}
        require({t["id"] for t in manifest["tables"]}==set(source_tables),"PLAN_TABLES","The plan omits or replaces a target table.")
        for t in manifest["tables"]:
            original=source_tables[t["id"]]
            require(all(t[k]==original[k] for k in ("headers","key","file","encoding","delimiter","allowRollbackDeleteCreated")),
                    "PLAN_TABLE_CONTRACT","A plan table differs from the agreed target.")
        h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
        with archive.open("operations.ndjson") as source:
            while True:
                check_stop(ctx["signal"]);chunk=source.read(1024*1024)
                if not chunk:break
                size+=len(chunk);require(size<=MAX_INPUT_BYTES,"PLAN_SIZE","The plan exceeds its declared expanded limit.");h.update(chunk)
        require(h.hexdigest()==manifest["operations"]["sha256"] and size==manifest["operations"]["bytes"],
                "PLAN_HASH","The original reviewed operations do not match the manifest.")
        before_snapshot=local_snapshot(db,target)
        require(before_snapshot==manifest["expectedSnapshotSha256"],"TARGET_SNAPSHOT_STALE",
                "The target changed after the reviewed export. Capture a fresh export and review the delta before applying.",
                {"expected":manifest["expectedSnapshotSha256"],"actual":before_snapshot})
        receipts=[];seen=set();counts={}
        with archive.open("operations.ndjson") as body:
            for line in io.TextIOWrapper(body,encoding="utf-8"):
                check_stop(ctx["signal"]);require(len(line.encode("utf-8"))<=64*1024*1024,"PLAN_ROW_SIZE","A planned row exceeds its declared limit.")
                op=json.loads(line);mid=op.get("mappingId");require(mid in source_tables,"PLAN_MAPPING","The plan names an unknown target table.")
                table=source_tables[mid];k=key(op.get("key"));identity=(mid,k)
                require(identity not in seen,"PLAN_DUPLICATE_KEY","A plan changes the same target key twice.");seen.add(identity)
                action=op.get("action");require(action in ("create","update","delete"),"PLAN_ACTION","Unknown local change action.")
                current=db.execute("SELECT * FROM local_rows WHERE target_id=? AND mapping_id=? AND target_key=?",(target["id"],mid,k)).fetchone()
                before=op.get("before");after=op.get("after")
                if action=="create":
                    require(current is None and before is None,"LOCAL_CREATE_COLLISION","The target key already exists.")
                    record_id=str(uuid.uuid4());version=1
                else:
                    require(current is not None and isinstance(before,dict) and current["record_id"]==before.get("targetId")
                            and str(current["version"])==before.get("version") and json.loads(current["cells_json"])==before.get("values"),
                            "LOCAL_RECORD_STALE","The actual target identity, version or fields changed after review.",{"mappingId":mid,"key":op["key"]})
                    record_id=current["record_id"];version=current["version"]+1
                if action=="delete":
                    require(manifest["kind"]=="rollback" and table["allowRollbackDeleteCreated"] and after is None,
                            "LOCAL_DELETE_SCOPE","Only an explicitly approved created-row rollback can delete a record.")
                    db.execute("DELETE FROM local_rows WHERE target_id=? AND mapping_id=? AND target_key=?",(target["id"],mid,k))
                else:
                    require(isinstance(after,list) and len(after)==len(table["headers"]) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in after),
                            "LOCAL_ROW_SHAPE","The planned target fields do not match the actual CSV contract.")
                    require([after[table["headers"].index(x)] for x in table["key"]]==op["key"],"LOCAL_KEY_CHANGED","The planned values change the reviewed key.")
                    if action=="create":
                        db.execute("INSERT INTO local_rows VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",(target["id"],mid,k,record_id,version,canonical(after)))
                    else:
                        db.execute("UPDATE local_rows SET version=?,cells_json=? WHERE target_id=? AND mapping_id=? AND target_key=?",
                                   (version,canonical(after),target["id"],mid,k))
                counts[action]=counts.get(action,0)+1
                receipts.append({"rowId":op["rowId"],"mappingId":mid,"key":op["key"],"action":action,
                                 "recordId":record_id,"version":str(version) if action!="delete" else None,"before":before,"after":after})
        require(len(receipts)==manifest["rows"] and counts==manifest["counts"],"PLAN_COUNT","The reviewed operation count differs from the actual instructions.")
        _relations(db,target,ctx["signal"])
    detail=store.put_bytes(canonical(receipts).encode("utf-8"),"owned-target-apply-receipt.json",db,ctx["signal"])
    result=store.put(db,"local-receipt",{"targetId":target["id"],"planId":manifest["planId"],"archive":data["archive"],
        "kind":manifest["kind"],"beforeSnapshotSha256":before_snapshot,"afterSnapshotSha256":local_snapshot(db,target),
        "counts":counts,"rows":len(receipts),"details":detail,"createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"],
        "scope":"Actual transaction in the owned local receiver; no external vendor system was contacted."},ctx["revision"])
    return {"receipt":result,"replayedPlan":False}

from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,os,sqlite3,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from .common import *
from receive_workspace import (receive_archive,artifact_work,clear_artifact_work,
                               write_artifact_record,sync_directory)

def application_files(application_root,signal=None):
    root=Path(application_root).absolute();path=root/"APPLICATION.json"
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),"APPLICATION_MANIFEST","The complete application source manifest is missing.")
    raw=path.read_bytes();manifest=json.loads(raw)
    require(manifest.get("schema")=="nelc.application-source/v1","APPLICATION_SCHEMA","The source edition is unsupported.")
    files=[]
    for item in manifest["files"]:
        check_stop(signal);relative=safe_relative(item["path"]);source=root/relative
        require(source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink() and file_hash(source,signal)==(item["sha256"],item["bytes"]),
                "APPLICATION_CHANGED","An installed application file differs from the complete source edition.",item["path"])
        files.append((str(relative),source))
    require(len({name for name,_ in files})==len(files) and "APPLICATION.json" not in {name for name,_ in files},
            "APPLICATION_MANIFEST","Application filenames repeat.")
    files.append(("APPLICATION.json",path))
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),files


_BACKUP_WORK=("snapshot.sqlite","snapshot.sqlite-journal","snapshot.sqlite-wal","snapshot.sqlite-shm",
              "archive.zip","READY.json","READY.json.pending","receipt.json.pending")

def _archive_receipt(path,output,id,selection,signal=None):
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),"BACKUP_PATH","The retained archive is not an ordinary file.")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        raw=archive.read("MANIFEST.json");manifest=json.loads(raw)
        require(manifest.get("schema")=="nelc.portable-workspace/v1" and manifest.get("selection")==selection,
                "BACKUP_COLLISION","The retained archive belongs to a different frozen selection.")
        require(manifest["workspace"]["id"]==selection["workspaceId"]
                and manifest["workspace"]["revision"]==selection["revision"]
                and manifest.get("applicationSha256")==selection["applicationSha256"],
                "BACKUP_SELECTION","The retained workspace or application differs from its frozen selection.")
        require(len(archive.infolist())==len(manifest["files"])+1
                and set(archive.namelist())=={"MANIFEST.json"}|{x["path"] for x in manifest["files"]},
                "BACKUP_MEMBERS","The retained archive is incomplete.")
        by_name={}
        for item in manifest["files"]:
            safe_relative(item["path"]);h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
            with archive.open(item["path"]) as source:
                while True:
                    check_stop(signal);chunk=source.read(1024*1024)
                    if not chunk:break
                    count+=len(chunk);h.update(chunk)
            require((h.hexdigest(),count)==(item["sha256"],item["bytes"]),
                    "BACKUP_HASH","The retained archive has an incomplete or changed member.",item["path"])
            by_name[item["path"]]=item
        app_raw=archive.read("application/APPLICATION.json")
        require(hashlib.sha256(app_raw).hexdigest()==selection["applicationSha256"],
                "BACKUP_APPLICATION","The archived application manifest differs from its selected original.")
        app=json.loads(app_raw)
        require(app.get("schema")=="nelc.application-source/v1","BACKUP_APPLICATION","The archived application source edition is unsupported.")
        for item in app["files"]:
            member=by_name.get("application/"+str(safe_relative(item["path"])))
            require(member is not None and (member["sha256"],member["bytes"])==(item["sha256"],item["bytes"]),
                    "BACKUP_APPLICATION","An archived application member differs from its original source edition.",item["path"])
    sha,size=file_hash(path,signal)
    return {"schema":"nelc.backup-receipt/v1","id":id,"selection":selection,"path":str(output),
            "sha256":sha,"bytes":size,"manifestSha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "workspace":manifest["workspace"],"applicationSha256":selection["applicationSha256"],
            "files":len(manifest["files"]),"createdAt":manifest["createdAt"]}

def _adopt_backup(output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal):
    require(not output.is_symlink() and not receipt_path.is_symlink(),
            "BACKUP_PATH","A frozen backup cannot be a symlink.")
    if receipt_path.is_file():
        receipt=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text("utf-8"))
        require(receipt["selection"]==selection and output.is_file()
                and file_hash(output,signal)==(receipt["sha256"],receipt["bytes"]),
                "BACKUP_CHANGED","The retained frozen backup differs from its original selection.")
        return receipt
    if output.is_file():
        receipt=_archive_receipt(output,output,id,selection,signal)
        write_artifact_record(work,"receipt.json",receipt,target=receipt_path)
        return receipt
    require(not output.exists() and not receipt_path.exists(),
            "BACKUP_PATH","The selected backup path is not an ordinary file.")
    return None

def _publish_backup(completed,receipt,output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal):
    check_stop(signal)
    try:
        os.link(completed,output)
    except FileExistsError:
        # Keep the original full selection, including applicationSha256. Never
        # recurse through a new application/current-head selection to adopt a winner.
        winner=_adopt_backup(output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal)
        require(winner is not None,"BACKUP_COLLISION","The concurrent backup publication is incomplete.")
        return winner
    sync_directory(output.parent)
    write_artifact_record(work,"receipt.json",receipt,target=receipt_path)
    return receipt

def backup(store,application_root,revision=None,signal=None):
    app_sha,app_files=application_files(application_root,signal)
    app_path=next(path for name,path in app_files if name=="APPLICATION.json")
    app_raw=app_path.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(app_raw).hexdigest()==app_sha,"APPLICATION_CHANGED",
            "The installed application changed while its original selection was being frozen.")
    app_manifest=json.loads(app_raw)
    app_expected={"application/"+str(safe_relative(x["path"])):(x["sha256"],x["bytes"]) for x in app_manifest["files"]}
    app_expected["application/APPLICATION.json"]=(app_sha,len(app_raw))
    require("application/receive_workspace.py" in app_expected,"APPLICATION_MANIFEST","The original complete receiving program is missing.")
    app_expected["RECEIVE.py"]=app_expected["application/receive_workspace.py"]
    meta=store.metadata();revision=meta["revision"] if revision is None else integer(revision,"backup revision")
    selection={"workspaceId":meta["id"],"revision":revision,"applicationSha256":app_sha}
    id="backup-"+digest(selection)[:28]
    directory=store.root/"exports";directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True);directory=directory.resolve(strict=True)
    output=directory/(id+".zip");receipt_path=directory/(id+".json")
    ownership={**selection,"output":str(output),"receipt":str(receipt_path)}
    with artifact_work(directory,"backup",ownership,signal,stop=lambda:check_stop(signal)) as work:
        db_temp=work/"snapshot.sqlite";zip_temp=work/"archive.zip";ready_path=work/"READY.json"
        try:
            retained=_adopt_backup(output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal)
            if retained is not None:return retained
            require(not ready_path.is_symlink(),"BACKUP_PATH","The completed original work receipt became a symlink.")
            if ready_path.is_file():
                # A process may have stopped after its complete archive was fsynced
                # but before publication. Its frozen selection can survive a newer head.
                saved=json.loads(ready_path.read_text("utf-8"))
                require(saved.get("selection")==selection,"BACKUP_SELECTION","The completed work belongs to a different original selection.")
                receipt=_archive_receipt(zip_temp,output,id,selection,signal)
                require(saved==receipt,"BACKUP_CHANGED","The completed original work differs from its retained receipt.")
                return _publish_backup(zip_temp,receipt,output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal)
            # A committed coordinator row establishes this exact partial work's
            # ownership. Remove it before testing capacity or taking another snapshot.
            clear_artifact_work(work,_BACKUP_WORK)
            work.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
            require(store.metadata()["revision"]==revision,"BACKUP_REVISION",
                    "Select the actual current revision before making a new complete backup.")
            with store.lock,store.connect() as db:
                db.execute("BEGIN")
                require(store.meta(db)["revision"]==revision,"BACKUP_REVISION","The workspace changed before snapshot acquisition.")
                history=store.audit(db,signal)
                destination=sqlite3.connect(db_temp)
                try:db.backup(destination,pages=256,progress=lambda *args:check_stop(signal))
                finally:destination.close()
                objects=[dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM objects ORDER BY sha256")]
                meta=store.meta(db)
            with db_temp.open("rb") as completed:os.fsync(completed.fileno())
            members=[("workspace/workspace.sqlite",db_temp)]
            for obj in objects:
                path=store.object_path(obj["sha256"])
                require(file_hash(path,signal)==(obj["sha256"],obj["bytes"]),"BACKUP_OBJECT","A selected source object is unavailable.")
                members.append(("workspace/objects/"+obj["sha256"][:2]+"/"+obj["sha256"],path))
            members.extend(("application/"+name,path) for name,path in app_files)
            receiver=next(path for name,path in app_files if name=="receive_workspace.py")
            members.append(("RECEIVE.py",receiver))
            open_text=("NELC service reporting and migration workbench\n\n"
              "This complete archive contains the original source files, the accepted operation history,\n"
              "the source and target working editions, and the complete offline application.\n\n"
              "Receive with the original archive SHA256 supplied alongside this file:\n"
              "  python3 RECEIVE.py ARCHIVE.zip --output NEW_DIRECTORY --sha256 ORIGINAL_SHA256\n\n"
              "In the received directory:\n"
              "  python3 application/cli.py --workspace workspace verify\n"
              "  python3 application/operator/server.py --workspace workspace\n\n"
              "Open the local URL printed by the operator. Its new local session token is not in this archive.\n"
              "Supplier acceptance, published aggregate figures, and the owned local receiving example remain distinct.\n").encode()
            files=[]
            for name,path in members:
                sha,size=file_hash(path,signal)
                if name in app_expected:
                    require((sha,size)==app_expected[name],"APPLICATION_CHANGED",
                            "An application member changed after its original source selection.",name)
                files.append({"path":name,"sha256":sha,"bytes":size})
            files.append({"path":"OPEN.txt","sha256":hashlib.sha256(open_text).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(open_text)})
            manifest={"schema":"nelc.portable-workspace/v1","selection":selection,"workspace":meta,"history":history,
                      "applicationSha256":app_sha,"files":files,"createdAt":now(),
                      "scope":"Complete selected workspace and application. Transient sessions, credentials, exports and unfinished task carriers are excluded."}
            raw=canonical(manifest).encode("utf-8")
            with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_temp,"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as archive:
                for name,path in members:
                    check_stop(signal);info=zipfile.ZipInfo(name,date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0));info.compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED;info.external_attr=(0o100600<<16)
                    with archive.open(info,"w") as out,path.open("rb") as source:
                        while True:
                            check_stop(signal);chunk=source.read(1024*1024)
                            if not chunk:break
                            out.write(chunk)
                archive.writestr("OPEN.txt",open_text);archive.writestr("MANIFEST.json",raw)
            receipt=_archive_receipt(zip_temp,output,id,selection,signal)
            with zip_temp.open("rb") as completed:os.fsync(completed.fileno())
            sync_directory(work)
            write_artifact_record(work,"READY.json",receipt)
            return _publish_backup(zip_temp,receipt,output,receipt_path,id,selection,work,signal)
        finally:
            # Terminal replay also reaches this cleanup. Hard process death leaves
            # the committed selection row and constant paths for this same request.
            clear_artifact_work(work,_BACKUP_WORK)

def receive(store,object_ref,name,signal=None):
    safe_name(name)
    with store.connect() as db:source=store.object(db,object_ref,signal)
    check_stop(signal)
    destination=store.root/"received"/name
    return receive_archive(source,destination,object_ref["sha256"],signal=signal)

from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path
from .common import *
from .contracts import save_contract
from .reporting import report

PROFILE_PATH=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"source"/"NHS-2025-26-native-profile.json"
ORG="E06000012"
def original_profile():
    return json.loads(PROFILE_PATH.read_text("utf-8"))
def checked_nhs_edition(store,db,id):
    edition=store.get(db,"edition",id)
    profile=original_profile()
    original=next(x for x in profile["retained_files"] if x["name"].endswith(".zip"))
    require(edition["original"]["sha256"]==original["sha256"] and edition["original"]["bytes"]==original["bytes"],
            "NHS_SOURCE_EDITION","The NHS preset binds only the complete retained 2025–26 original ZIP.")
    tables={}
    for native in original["members"]:
        found=[x for x in edition["tables"] if x["name"]==native["name"]]
        require(len(found)==1,"NHS_MEMBER","An original NHS member is missing.")
        table=found[0]
        require(table["object"]["sha256"]==native["sha256"] and table["object"]["bytes"]==native["bytes"]
                and table["headers"]==native["header"] and table["rows"]==native["data_rows"],
                "NHS_MEMBER_CHANGED","The parsed table differs from the retained native source profile.")
        code_index=table["headers"].index("OrgCode")
        count=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM rows WHERE edition_id=? AND table_id=? AND json_extract(cells_json,?)=?",
                         (id,table["id"],f"$[{code_index}]",ORG)).fetchone()[0]
        require(count==native["north_east_lincolnshire_rows"],"NHS_SCOPE_COUNT","The selected authority count differs from the original native profile.")
        tables["finance" if "finance" in native["name"] else "service"]=table
    return edition,tables,profile

def nhs_contract(store,db,data,ctx):
    edition,tables,profile=checked_nhs_edition(store,db,data.get("editionId"))
    mappings=[]
    for ident,table in tables.items():
        headers=table["headers"];dimensions=["FinancialYear","OrgType","OrgCode"]
        if ident=="service":dimensions+=["Quarter","Sex","MonitoringCategoryType","MonitoringCategory"]
        numeric_start=7 if ident=="finance" else 10
        cols=[{"name":h,"source":i,"transform":"identity","type":"decimal" if i>=numeric_start else "text","required":False}
              for i,h in enumerate(headers)]
        cols.append({"name":"Migration review note","source":None,"transform":"constant","constant":"","type":"text","required":False})
        mappings.append({"id":ident,"entity":"Published aggregate "+ident+" record",
            "sourceTableId":table["id"],"sourceKey":[headers.index(h) for h in dimensions],
            "scope":[{"column":headers.index("OrgCode"),"op":"equals","value":ORG}],
            "target":{"table":ident+".csv","columns":cols,"key":dimensions,"encoding":"utf-8-sig","delimiter":",",
                      "allowRollbackDeleteCreated":True}})
    definition={"name":"NELC published NHS aggregate → owned local receiving contract",
        "editionId":edition["id"],"authority":"Owned local receiving demonstration. This is not QuitManager's vendor CSV contract.",
        "tables":mappings,"relationships":[],"rules":[],
        "sourceTokens":{t:{"meaning":"Uninterpreted original publisher token; retained unchanged.",
                          "source":"Original NHS CSV pack and its separately retained annual workbook notes."} for t in (":","*","z")},
        "note":"The actual 676 service and one finance rows are distinct aggregate records. No patient, episode or clinical-rule mapping is inferred.",
        "evidence":[{"path":"source/NHS-2025-26-native-profile.json","sourceArchiveSha256":edition["original"]["sha256"],
                     "locator":"Both original headers, member hashes, row counts and OrgCode E06000012."}]}
    return save_contract(store,db,{"definition":definition,"reason":"Draft from the verified original NHS edition; explicit local review is still required."},ctx)

def nhs_report(store,db,data,ctx):
    edition,tables,profile=checked_nhs_edition(store,db,data.get("editionId"))
    kind=data.get("table","service");require(kind in tables,"NHS_REPORT_TABLE","Choose the original service or finance table.")
    table=tables[kind];headers=table["headers"]
    dimensions=["FinancialYear","OrgType","OrgCode"]
    filters=[{"column":headers.index("OrgCode"),"value":ORG}]
    if kind=="service":
        dimensions+=["Quarter","Sex","MonitoringCategoryType","MonitoringCategory"]
        filters += [{"column":headers.index("Sex"),"value":"All persons"},
                    {"column":headers.index("MonitoringCategoryType"),"value":"Age band"},
                    {"column":headers.index("MonitoringCategory"),"value":"All ages"}]
        if data.get("quarter") is not None:filters.append({"column":headers.index("Quarter"),"value":text(data["quarter"],"original quarter")})
        metrics=[{"column":i,"kind":"percentage" if "(%)" in h or "quitters (%)" in h else "count",
                  "unit":"%" if "%" in h else "people as published"} for i,h in enumerate(headers) if i>=10]
    else:
        metrics=[{"column":i,"kind":"currency","unit":"GBP as published"} for i in range(7,len(headers))]
    definition={"name":data.get("name") or ("NELC NHS "+kind+" original values"),
        "dimensions":[headers.index(x) for x in dimensions],"filters":filters,"metrics":metrics,"aggregation":"source-rows",
        "values":"original","sourceTokens":{t:{"meaning":"Uninterpreted original source token"} for t in (":","*","z")},
        "period":profile["source_period"],"basis":"Exact published source rows, without addition across overlapping dimensions.",
        "quality":{"rateSuppression":"The current NHS annual data-quality statement says rates with denominator 1–20 inclusive are suppressed for accuracy.",
                   "source":"NHS Stop Smoking Services England, April 2025 to March 2026 (Q4 annual), Data quality statement, published 23 July 2026.",
                   "markerInterpretation":"The exact workbook token legend is retained separately; CSV strings are unchanged."}}
    return report(store,db,{"editionId":edition["id"],"tableId":table["id"],"definition":definition},ctx)

from __future__ import annotations
import csv, io, json, os, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from .common import *
from .contracts import approval

def zip_objects(store,db,members,name,signal=None):
    fd,temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".zip-",dir=store.root)
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary,"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as archive:
            for filename,ref in members:
                check_stop(signal);safe_relative(filename)
                path=store.object(db,ref,signal)
                info=zipfile.ZipInfo(filename,date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0));info.compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                info.external_attr=(0o100600<<16)
                with archive.open(info,"w") as out,path.open("rb") as source:
                    while True:
                        check_stop(signal);chunk=source.read(1024*1024)
                        if not chunk:break
                        out.write(chunk)
        with open(temporary,"rb") as stream:return store.put_stream(stream,name,MAX_INPUT_BYTES,signal,db=db)
    finally:
        try:os.unlink(temporary)
        except FileNotFoundError:pass

def release(store,db,data,ctx):
    contract=store.get(db,"contract",data.get("contractId"))
    review=approval(store,db,contract)
    require(review is not None,"CONTRACT_NOT_APPROVED","Review and approve the exact mapping before releasing CSV files.")
    assessment=store.get(db,"assessment",data.get("assessmentId"))
    require(assessment["contractId"]==contract["id"] and assessment["ready"],"ASSESSMENT_NOT_READY","Resolve every blocking assessment finding.")
    current=sorted(c["id"] for c in store.corrections(db,contract["definition"]["editionId"]).values())
    require(current==assessment["correctionIds"],"ASSESSMENT_STALE","Corrections changed after assessment; assess the same contract again.")
    name=text(data.get("name"),"release name",maximum=300);reason=text(data.get("reason"),"release review")
    files=[];lineage=[];tables=[]
    for mapping in contract["definition"]["tables"]:
        check_stop(ctx["signal"]);target=mapping["target"];headers=[c["name"] for c in target["columns"]]
        fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".csv-",dir=store.root)
        fd2,tmp2=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".lineage-",dir=store.root)
        count=0
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding=target["encoding"],newline="") as out,os.fdopen(fd2,"w",encoding="utf-8",newline="") as links:
                writer=csv.writer(out,delimiter=target["delimiter"],lineterminator="\r\n")
                line_writer=csv.writer(links,lineterminator="\r\n")
                writer.writerow(headers);line_writer.writerow(["Target CSV record","Source row ID","Target key JSON","Mapped row SHA256"])
                for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM mapped_rows WHERE assessment_id=? AND mapping_id=? ORDER BY row_id",(assessment["id"],mapping["id"])):
                    check_stop(ctx["signal"]);count+=1;writer.writerow(json.loads(row["cells_json"]))
                    line_writer.writerow([count+1,row["row_id"],row["target_key"],row["sha256"]])
                out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno());links.flush();os.fsync(links.fileno())
            with open(tmp,"rb") as source:ref=store.put_stream(source,target["table"],MAX_MEMBER_BYTES,ctx["signal"],db=db)
            with open(tmp2,"rb") as source:lin=store.put_stream(source,mapping["id"]+"-lineage.csv",MAX_MEMBER_BYTES,ctx["signal"],db=db)
        except UnicodeError as error:
            raise Problem("TARGET_ENCODING","A mapped value cannot be represented in the agreed target encoding.",str(error))
        finally:
            for path in (tmp,tmp2):
                try:os.unlink(path)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
        files.append((target["table"],ref));lineage.append(lin)
        tables.append({"id":mapping["id"],"entity":mapping["entity"],"file":target["table"],"object":ref,"headers":headers,
                       "key":target["key"],"encoding":target["encoding"],"delimiter":target["delimiter"],"rows":count,
                       "lineage":lin,"allowRollbackDeleteCreated":target.get("allowRollbackDeleteCreated",False)})
    manifest={"schema":"nelc.csv-release/v1","name":name,"contractId":contract["id"],"definitionSha256":contract["definitionSha256"],
        "targetSignature":contract["targetSignature"],"assessmentId":assessment["id"],"effectiveSha256":assessment["effectiveSha256"],
        "approvalId":review["id"],"editionId":contract["definition"]["editionId"],"tables":tables,
        "relationships":contract["definition"].get("relationships",[]),"reason":reason,"createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"],
        "acceptance":"Prepared CSV release. Supplier import and per-record acceptance remain separate returned evidence."}
    manifest_ref=store.put_bytes(canonical(manifest).encode("utf-8"),"RELEASE.json",db,ctx["signal"])
    archive=zip_objects(store,db,files,"vendor-csv-release.zip",ctx["signal"])
    return store.put(db,"release",{**manifest,"manifest":manifest_ref,"archive":archive},ctx["revision"])

def load_release(store,db,manifest_ref,archive_ref,signal=None):
    manifest_path=store.object(db,manifest_ref,signal);archive_path=store.object(db,archive_ref,signal)
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text("utf-8"))
    require(manifest.get("schema")=="nelc.csv-release/v1","RELEASE_SCHEMA","Select a complete original CSV release and its manifest.")
    require(1<=len(manifest.get("tables",[]))<=MAX_TABLES,"RELEASE_TABLES","The release has an invalid table count.")
    files=[t["file"] for t in manifest["tables"]]
    require(len(files)==len(set(files)),"RELEASE_MEMBERS","Release filenames must be unique.")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        require(len(archive.infolist())==len(files) and set(archive.namelist())==set(files),"RELEASE_MEMBERS","The ZIP differs from its exact manifest.")
        for table in manifest["tables"]:
            check_stop(signal);safe_name(table["file"])
            h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
            with archive.open(table["file"]) as source:
                while True:
                    check_stop(signal);chunk=source.read(1024*1024)
                    if not chunk:break
                    count+=len(chunk);require(count<=MAX_MEMBER_BYTES,"RELEASE_SIZE","A target member exceeds the intake limit.");h.update(chunk)
            require(h.hexdigest()==table["object"]["sha256"] and count==table["object"]["bytes"],"RELEASE_HASH","A target CSV differs from the reviewed release.")
    return manifest,archive_path

from __future__ import annotations
import csv, hashlib, io, json
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from .common import *
from .intake import table_in

def report(store,db,data,ctx):
    edition=store.get(db,"edition",data.get("editionId")); table=table_in(edition,data.get("tableId"))
    definition=data.get("definition",{})
    require(isinstance(definition,dict),"REPORT_DEFINITION","Supply an explicit report definition.")
    name=text(definition.get("name"),"report name",maximum=300)
    dimensions=definition.get("dimensions",[])
    require(isinstance(dimensions,list) and dimensions and len(dimensions)==len(set(dimensions)),
            "REPORT_DIMENSIONS","Select distinct dimensions that identify each displayed source row.")
    for c in dimensions:column(c,table["headers"])
    metrics=definition.get("metrics",[])
    require(isinstance(metrics,list) and metrics,"REPORT_METRICS","Select the actual reported value columns.")
    for m in metrics:
        require(isinstance(m,dict),"REPORT_METRIC","Each metric must identify its original column.")
        column(m.get("column"),table["headers"])
        require(m.get("kind") in ("count","currency","percentage","text"),"REPORT_METRIC_KIND","Declare the metric's published unit.")
        text(m.get("unit",""),"metric unit",nonempty=False,maximum=100)
    require(len({m["column"] for m in metrics})==len(metrics) and not set(dimensions)&{m["column"] for m in metrics},
            "REPORT_COLUMNS","Dimensions and metric columns must be distinct.")
    filters=definition.get("filters",[])
    require(isinstance(filters,list),"REPORT_FILTER","Filters must be a list of exact source selections.")
    for x in filters:column(x.get("column"),table["headers"]);text(x.get("value"),"filter value",nonempty=False)
    require(definition.get("aggregation","source-rows")=="source-rows","REPORT_AGGREGATION",
            "This report retains original rows. Combining overlapping dimensions requires a separately supplied reporting rule.")
    mode=definition.get("values","original")
    require(mode in ("original","reviewed"),"REPORT_VALUES","Select original values or explicitly reviewed corrections.")
    corrections=store.corrections(db,edition["id"],table["id"]) if mode=="reviewed" else {}
    correction_ids=sorted(c["id"] for c in corrections.values())
    tokens=definition.get("sourceTokens",{":":{"meaning":"uninterpreted"},"*":{"meaning":"uninterpreted"},"z":{"meaning":"uninterpreted"}})
    require(isinstance(tokens,dict),"REPORT_TOKENS","Preserve the actual source token declarations.")
    columns=dimensions+[m["column"] for m in metrics]
    require(len({table["headers"][i] for i in columns})==len(columns),"REPORT_HEADERS","Use uniquely named columns for this report export.")
    output=io.StringIO(newline="");writer=csv.writer(output,lineterminator="\r\n")
    headers=["Source row ID","Source record"]+[table["headers"][i] for i in columns]
    writer.writerow(headers); selected=0; token_counts={}; keys={}; collisions=[]; preview=[]
    excluded=[];outside_scope=0
    for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM rows WHERE edition_id=? AND table_id=? ORDER BY ordinal",(edition["id"],table["id"])):
        check_stop(ctx["signal"]);cells=store.effective_cells(row,corrections)
        if any(x["column"]<len(cells) and cells[x["column"]]!=x["value"] for x in filters):
            outside_scope+=1;continue
        if len(cells)!=len(table["headers"]):
            excluded.append({"rowId":row["row_id"],"sourceRow":row["ordinal"],"sourceSha256":table["object"]["sha256"],
                "rowSha256":row["sha256"],"reason":"ROW_WIDTH","observedColumns":len(cells),"expectedColumns":len(table["headers"]),
                "populationMatch":"selected" if all(x["column"]<len(cells) for x in filters) else "undetermined"})
            continue
        selected+=1; values=[cells[i] for i in columns]; identity=key([cells[i] for i in dimensions])
        if identity in keys:
            collisions.append({"dimensionValues":json.loads(identity),"rowIds":[keys[identity],row["row_id"]]})
        else:keys[identity]=row["row_id"]
        for m in metrics:
            value=cells[m["column"]]
            if value in tokens:
                token_counts[value]=token_counts.get(value,0)+1
        writer.writerow([row["row_id"],row["ordinal"],*values])
        if len(preview)<40:preview.append({"rowId":row["row_id"],"sourceRow":row["ordinal"],"values":values})
    require(not collisions,"REPORT_DIMENSION_COLLISION","The selected dimensions do not uniquely identify the original rows.",
            {"groups":collisions[:50],"count":len(collisions)})
    artifact=store.put_bytes(output.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig"),"report.csv",db,ctx["signal"])
    exclusion_ref=store.put_bytes(canonical(excluded).encode("utf-8"),"report-excluded-source-rows.json",db,ctx["signal"]) if excluded else None
    return store.put(db,"report",{"name":name,"editionId":edition["id"],"tableId":table["id"],
        "sourceSha256":table["object"]["sha256"],"definition":definition,"correctionIds":correction_ids,
        "headers":headers,"dimensionHeaders":[table["headers"][i] for i in dimensions],
        "metrics":[{"header":table["headers"][m["column"]],"kind":m["kind"],"unit":m.get("unit","")} for m in metrics],
        "rows":selected,"preview":preview,"tokenCounts":token_counts,"artifact":artifact,
        "complete":not excluded,"outcome":"INCOMPLETE_SOURCE_ROWS" if excluded else "COMPLETE_SELECTED_ROWS",
        "population":{"sourceRows":table["rows"],"selectedRows":selected,"outsideScopeRows":outside_scope,
                      "excludedRows":len(excluded),"undeterminedScopeRows":sum(x["populationMatch"]=="undetermined" for x in excluded)},
        "excludedRows":len(excluded),"exclusions":exclusion_ref,"exclusionPreview":excluded[:40],
        "interpretation":"Every line is one original selected source row. Percentages and overlapping dimension totals have not been summed.",
        "createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"]},ctx["revision"])

def _read_report(store,db,r,keys,signal):
    path=store.object(db,r["artifact"],signal)
    rows={}
    with path.open("r",encoding="utf-8-sig",newline="") as stream:
        reader=csv.DictReader(stream)
        require(all(k in reader.fieldnames for k in keys),"REPORT_COMPARE_KEY","Comparison keys must be actual report columns.")
        for row in reader:
            check_stop(signal); k=key([row[x] for x in keys])
            require(k not in rows,"REPORT_COMPARE_COLLISION","The selected comparison key collapses more than one report row.",json.loads(k))
            rows[k]=row
    return rows

def compare_reports(store,db,data,ctx):
    first=store.get(db,"report",data.get("firstReportId")); second=store.get(db,"report",data.get("secondReportId"))
    keys=data.get("keyHeaders")
    require(isinstance(keys,list) and keys and len(keys)==len(set(keys)),"REPORT_COMPARE_KEY","Declare the comparison dimensions explicitly.")
    metrics=data.get("metricHeaders")
    require(isinstance(metrics,list) and metrics and len(metrics)==len(set(metrics)),"REPORT_COMPARE_METRICS","Select distinct comparable source measures.")
    first_types={m["header"]:m for m in first["metrics"]}; second_types={m["header"]:m for m in second["metrics"]}
    require(all(m in first_types and m in second_types and first_types[m]==second_types[m] for m in metrics),
            "REPORT_COMPARE_UNITS","Both reports must use the same declared metric names and units.")
    context=text(data.get("reason"),"comparison purpose and period/basis")
    a=_read_report(store,db,first,keys,ctx["signal"]);b=_read_report(store,db,second,keys,ctx["signal"])
    rows=[]; counts={}; out=io.StringIO(newline="");writer=csv.writer(out,lineterminator="\r\n")
    writer.writerow([*keys,"Metric","First raw","Second raw","State","Numeric difference (second - first)","Difference unit","First row","Second row"])
    token_values=set(first["definition"].get("sourceTokens",{":":{},"*":{},"z":{}}))|set(second["definition"].get("sourceTokens",{":":{},"*":{},"z":{}}))
    for k in sorted(set(a)|set(b)):
        check_stop(ctx["signal"])
        for metric in metrics:
            x=a.get(k);y=b.get(k);v1=x[metric] if x else None;v2=y[metric] if y else None
            state="same" if v1==v2 else ("only-in-second" if x is None else "only-in-first" if y is None else "different")
            delta=None;unit=first_types[metric]["unit"]
            if v1 is not None and v2 is not None and first_types[metric]["kind"]!="text" and v1 not in token_values and v2 not in token_values:
                try:
                    left,right=number(v2),number(v1)
                    exponent=min(left.as_tuple().exponent,right.as_tuple().exponent)
                    highest=max(left.adjusted() if left else 0,right.adjusted() if right else 0,0)
                    precision=max(len(left.as_tuple().digits),len(right.as_tuple().digits),highest-exponent+3)
                    require(precision<=MAX_CELL_BYTES,"REPORT_DIFFERENCE_SIZE","The exact decimal difference exceeds the retained cell limit.")
                    with localcontext() as decimal_context:
                        decimal_context.prec=precision;decimal_context.Emax=max(decimal_context.Emax,highest+2);decimal_context.Emin=min(decimal_context.Emin,exponent-2)
                        delta=format(left-right,"f")
                except Problem:delta=None
                if first_types[metric]["kind"]=="percentage":unit="percentage points"
            counts[state]=counts.get(state,0)+1
            item={"key":json.loads(k),"metric":metric,"firstRaw":v1,"secondRaw":v2,"state":state,
                  "difference":delta,"differenceUnit":unit,"firstRowId":x.get("Source row ID") if x else None,
                  "secondRowId":y.get("Source row ID") if y else None}
            rows.append(item);writer.writerow([*item["key"],metric,v1 if v1 is not None else "",v2 if v2 is not None else "",
                state,delta or "",unit,item["firstRowId"] or "",item["secondRowId"] or ""])
    artifact=store.put_bytes(out.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig"),"report-comparison.csv",db,ctx["signal"])
    details=store.put_bytes(canonical(rows).encode("utf-8"),"report-comparison.json",db,ctx["signal"])
    return store.put(db,"report-comparison",{"firstReportId":first["id"],"secondReportId":second["id"],
        "keyHeaders":keys,"metricHeaders":metrics,"reason":context,"counts":counts,"rows":len(rows),
        "preview":rows[:40],"artifact":artifact,"details":details,"createdAt":ctx["at"],"actor":ctx["actor"],
        "complete":first.get("complete",True) and second.get("complete",True),
        "sourcePopulations":{"first":first.get("population"),"second":second.get("population")},
        "sourceExclusions":{"first":first.get("exclusions"),"second":second.get("exclusions")},
        "interpretation":"Differences compare the selected native rows and units. Source tokens remain strings; missing report rows do not imply deletion."},ctx["revision"])

from __future__ import annotations
import json
from .common import *
from .storage import Store
from .intake import import_edition,correct,row_page
from .contracts import save_contract,approve_contract,assess,findings_page
from .reporting import report,compare_reports
from .releases import release
from .migration import import_return,accept_baseline,compare_target,comparison_page,plan_delta,verify_plan,plan_rollback
from .local_target import open_target,export_target,apply_plan
from .presets import nhs_contract,nhs_report
from .ndtms import analyse_ndtms,publish_ndtms,ndtms_page,verify_ndtms

ACTIONS={
 "analyse-ndtms":analyse_ndtms,"publish-ndtms":publish_ndtms,
 "draft-nhs-contract":nhs_contract,"nhs-report":nhs_report,
 "import-edition":import_edition,"save-contract":save_contract,"approve-contract":approve_contract,
 "correct-cell":correct,"assess":assess,"release":release,"import-target-return":import_return,
 "accept-baseline":accept_baseline,"compare-target":compare_target,"plan-delta":plan_delta,
 "verify-plan":verify_plan,"plan-rollback":plan_rollback,"report":report,"compare-reports":compare_reports,
 "open-local-target":open_target,"export-local-target":export_target,"apply-local-plan":apply_plan
}

class Workspace(Store):
    def mutate(self,request,signal=None):
        require(isinstance(request,dict) and set(request)=={"requestId","expectedRevision","actor","action","data"},
                "REQUEST_SHAPE","An operation contains exactly requestId, expectedRevision, actor, action and data.")
        request=json.loads(canonical(request))
        request_id=text(request["requestId"],"request ID",maximum=160)
        integer(request["expectedRevision"],"expected revision")
        actor=request["actor"];require(isinstance(actor,dict) and set(actor)=={"id","name"},"ACTOR","Supply a local workflow actor ID and name.")
        text(actor["id"],"actor ID",maximum=160);text(actor["name"],"actor name",maximum=300)
        action=request["action"];require(action in ACTIONS,"ACTION","Select a supported workbench operation.")
        require(isinstance(request["data"],dict),"OPERATION_DATA","Operation data must be an object.")
        request_sha=digest(request);check_stop(signal)
        with self.lock,self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                old=db.execute("SELECT request_sha,result_json FROM events WHERE request_id=?",(request_id,)).fetchone()
                if old:
                    require(old["request_sha"]==request_sha,"REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT","This request ID already belongs to different original input.")
                    result=json.loads(old["result_json"]);db.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return {**result,"duplicate":True}
                meta=self.meta(db)
                require(meta["revision"]==request["expectedRevision"],"REVISION_CONFLICT",
                        "The workspace changed after review. Refresh it before preparing a new request.",
                        {"expected":request["expectedRevision"],"current":meta["revision"]})
                revision=meta["revision"]+1;at=now()
                ctx={"revision":revision,"at":at,"actor":actor,"signal":signal,"requestId":request_id}
                result=ACTIONS[action](self,db,request["data"],ctx)
                check_stop(signal)
                operation_id="operation-"+request_sha[:28]
                response={"schema":"nelc.operation/v1","operationId":operation_id,"requestId":request_id,
                          "workspaceId":meta["id"],"revision":revision,"action":action,"result":result,"duplicate":False}
                previous=db.execute("SELECT sha256 FROM events ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
                previous_sha=previous[0] if previous else "0"*64
                event={"seq":revision,"id":operation_id,"requestSha256":request_sha,"request":request,
                       "result":response,"createdAt":at,"previousSha256":previous_sha}
                db.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",(revision,operation_id,request_id,request_sha,
                    canonical(request),canonical(response),at,previous_sha,digest(event)))
                db.execute("UPDATE meta SET value=? WHERE key='revision'",(str(revision),))
                db.execute("COMMIT")
                return response
            except BaseException:
                if db.in_transaction:db.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise
    def metadata(self):
        with self.connect() as db:return self.meta(db)
    def overview(self):
        with self.lock,self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN")
            meta=self.meta(db);groups={}
            for kind in KINDS:
                rows=self.list(db,kind,0,30);items=[]
                for value in rows["items"]:
                    definition=value.get("definition",{})
                    label=value.get("name") or definition.get("name") or value.get("targetName") or value.get("id")
                    summary={k:value[k] for k in ("id","schema","createdAt","rows","mappedRows","ready","findingCounts","findingCount",
                            "counts","contractId","editionId","targetSignature","snapshotSha256","allFieldsMatched","allRowsAccepted",
                            "kind","targetId","planId") if k in value}
                    summary["name"]=label
                    if kind=="edition":summary["tables"]=[{"id":t["id"],"name":t["name"],"rows":t["rows"],"headers":t["headers"]} for t in value["tables"]]
                    if kind=="contract":summary["definitionSha256"]=value["definitionSha256"]
                    items.append(summary)
                groups[kind]={"items":items,"total":rows["total"],"nextOffset":rows["nextOffset"]}
            return {"schema":"nelc.overview/v1","workspace":meta,"records":groups,
                    "sourceRows":db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM rows").fetchone()[0],
                    "originalBytes":db.execute("SELECT coalesce(sum(bytes),0) FROM objects").fetchone()[0],
                    "actorScope":"Actor names label this local workflow. They do not establish multi-user identities or supplier approval."}
    def record(self,kind,id):
        require(kind in KINDS,"RECORD_KIND","Select a supported record kind.")
        with self.lock,self.connect() as db:return self.get(db,kind,id)
    def page(self,kind,selection=None,revision=None,offset=0,limit=50):
        selection=selection or {};integer(offset,"offset");integer(limit,"limit",1,200)
        with self.lock,self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN");meta=self.meta(db)
            if offset or revision is not None:
                require(revision==meta["revision"],"PAGE_REVISION","Continue pages at the same workspace revision.",meta["revision"])
            if kind=="source-rows":
                result=row_page(self,db,selection.get("editionId"),selection.get("tableId"),offset,limit,selection.get("filters",[]))
            elif kind in ("ndtms-findings","ndtms-rows","ndtms-lineage"):
                result=ndtms_page(self,db,kind,selection,offset,limit)
            elif kind=="findings":
                self.get(db,"assessment",selection.get("assessmentId"));result=findings_page(db,selection["assessmentId"],offset,limit)
            elif kind=="comparison-rows":
                self.get(db,"comparison",selection.get("comparisonId"))
                result=comparison_page(db,selection["comparisonId"],offset,limit,selection.get("status"))
            elif kind=="plan-rows":
                self.get(db,"plan",selection.get("planId"))
                count=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM plan_rows WHERE plan_id=?",(selection["planId"],)).fetchone()[0]
                rows=db.execute("SELECT data_json FROM plan_rows WHERE plan_id=? ORDER BY row_id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(selection["planId"],limit,offset)).fetchall()
                result={"items":[json.loads(r[0]) for r in rows],"total":count,"offset":offset,"nextOffset":offset+len(rows) if offset+len(rows)<count else None}
            elif kind=="operations":
                count=meta["revision"]
                rows=db.execute("SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",(limit,offset)).fetchall()
                result={"items":[{"revision":r["seq"],"id":r["id"],"request":json.loads(r["request_json"]),
                         "response":json.loads(r["result_json"]),"createdAt":r["created_at"],"sha256":r["sha256"]} for r in rows],
                        "total":count,"offset":offset,"nextOffset":offset+len(rows) if offset+len(rows)<count else None}
            else:
                require(kind in KINDS,"PAGE_KIND","Select a supported record table.");result=self.list(db,kind,offset,limit)
            return {"schema":"nelc.page/v1","revision":meta["revision"],"kind":kind,**result}
    def verify(self,full=True,signal=None):
        with self.lock,self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN")
            require(db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok","DATABASE_INTEGRITY","The received SQLite database failed its integrity check.")
            history=self.audit(db,signal)
            count=0;size=0
            for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM objects ORDER BY sha256"):
                check_stop(signal)
                require(file_hash(self.object_path(row["sha256"]),signal)==(row["sha256"],row["bytes"]),"OBJECT_CHANGED","A retained original or artifact failed its hash.")
                count+=1;size+=row["bytes"]
            checked_rows=0
            if full:
                table_sources={}
                for record in db.execute("SELECT data_json FROM records WHERE kind='edition'"):
                    e=json.loads(record[0])
                    for table in e["tables"]:table_sources[table["id"]]=table["object"]["sha256"]
                for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY edition_id,table_id,ordinal"):
                    check_stop(signal)
                    require(digest({"sourceSha256":table_sources[row["table_id"]],"sourceRow":row["ordinal"],"values":json.loads(row["cells_json"])})==row["sha256"],
                            "SOURCE_ROW_HASH","A retained source row differs from its intake proof.",row["row_id"])
                    checked_rows+=1
                for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM mapped_rows ORDER BY assessment_id,mapping_id,row_id"):
                    check_stop(signal)
                    require(digest({"sourceRowId":row["row_id"],"key":json.loads(row["target_key"]),"values":json.loads(row["cells_json"])})==row["sha256"],
                            "MAPPED_ROW_HASH","A mapped row differs from its reviewed projection.")
            ndtms_count=verify_ndtms(self,db,signal) if full else None
            return {"ndtmsAnalyses":ndtms_count,"schema":"nelc.workspace-verification/v1","workspace":self.meta(db),"history":history,
                    "objects":count,"bytes":size,"checkedSourceRows":checked_rows,"complete":True}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Receive a complete NELC workbench archive without installing dependencies."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, contextlib, hashlib, json, os, shutil, signal as signals, sqlite3, stat, threading, time, zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import quote

def require(value,message):
    if not value:raise ValueError(message)
def check_stop(signal=None):
    if signal is not None and signal.is_set():raise InterruptedError('The original receiving operation was interrupted.')
def sha_file(path,signal=None):
    h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
    with open(path,"rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b""):check_stop(signal);h.update(chunk);size+=len(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest(),size
def canonical(value):return json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False)
def relative(name):
    p=PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not p.is_absolute() and str(p)==name and "\\" not in name and "\x00" not in name
            and all(x not in ("",".","..") for x in p.parts),"Unsafe archive member.")
    return p

def sync_directory(path):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY)
    try:os.fsync(fd)
    finally:os.close(fd)

@contextlib.contextmanager
def artifact_work(parent,kind,selection,signal=None,stop=None):
    """Hold one native SQLite ownership transaction outside the workspace database.

    The committed row binds a constant work directory to the complete original
    selection before any bulk file is created. Process death releases the native
    lock; a later caller may reconcile only that row's exact owned work. Keep the
    coordinator itself in place so waiting callers cannot acquire a new inode.
    """
    parent=Path(parent).resolve(strict=True)
    require(parent.is_dir(),"The artifact parent is not a directory.")
    require(kind in ("backup","receive"),"Unknown artifact work kind.")
    selected={"schema":"nelc.artifact-work/v1","kind":kind,"parent":str(parent),"selection":selection}
    key=hashlib.sha256(canonical(selected).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    work=parent/(".nelc-"+kind+"-"+key)
    marker=canonical({**selected,"workDirectory":str(work)})
    control=parent/".nelc-artifacts.sqlite"
    require(not control.is_symlink() and (not control.exists() or control.is_file()),
            "The artifact coordinator is not an ordinary file.")
    try:
        fd=os.open(control,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    except FileExistsError:
        pass
    else:
        os.close(fd);sync_directory(parent)
    check=stop if stop is not None else lambda:check_stop(signal)
    db=sqlite3.connect(control,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
    def acquire():
        while True:
            check()
            try:
                db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                return
            except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
                code=getattr(exc,"sqlite_errorcode",0) or 0
                if (code&255) not in (sqlite3.SQLITE_BUSY,sqlite3.SQLITE_LOCKED):
                    raise
                time.sleep(0.05)
    try:
        db.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
        acquire()
        tables={row[0] for row in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")}
        require(tables<= {"artifact_work"},"The artifact coordinator contains unrelated data.")
        db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artifact_work(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,marker TEXT NOT NULL)")
        row=db.execute("SELECT marker FROM artifact_work WHERE id=?",(key,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            require(not work.exists() and not work.is_symlink(),"Unregistered artifact work already occupies the selected path.")
            db.execute("INSERT INTO artifact_work VALUES(?,?)",(key,marker))
        else:
            require(row[0]==marker,"The retained artifact selection differs from this request.")
        db.commit()
        sync_directory(parent)
        acquire()
        require(db.execute("SELECT marker FROM artifact_work WHERE id=?",(key,)).fetchone()[0]==marker,
                "The committed artifact owner changed.")
        require(not work.is_symlink() and (not work.exists() or work.is_dir()),
                "The owned artifact work path is not an ordinary directory.")
        work.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
        sync_directory(parent)
        yield work
    finally:
        if db.in_transaction:db.rollback()
        db.close()

def clear_artifact_work(work,names):
    """Remove only constant names under the currently locked original owner."""
    for name in names:
        require(len(relative(name).parts)==1,"An artifact work name must be local.")
        path=work/name
        require(not path.is_symlink(),"An owned artifact path became a symlink.")
        if path.is_dir():shutil.rmtree(path)
        elif path.exists():
            require(path.is_file(),"An owned artifact path is not ordinary.")
            path.unlink()
    if work.exists():
        sync_directory(work)
        if not any(work.iterdir()):
            work.rmdir();sync_directory(work.parent)

def write_artifact_record(work,name,value,target=None):
    """Write a recoverable receipt through one constant, positively owned file."""
    require(len(relative(name).parts)==1,"An artifact receipt name must be local.")
    pending=work/(name+".pending")
    target=work/name if target is None else Path(target)
    require(not pending.is_symlink() and (not pending.exists() or pending.is_file()),
            "The owned receipt staging path is not ordinary.")
    require(not target.is_symlink() and (not target.exists() or target.is_file()),
            "The receipt destination is not ordinary.")
    with pending.open("wb") as out:
        out.write((canonical(value)+"\n").encode("utf-8"));out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
    os.chmod(pending,0o600)
    os.replace(pending,target)
    sync_directory(target.parent)

def db_state(path,manifest):
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),"The received database is not an ordinary file.")
    db=sqlite3.connect("file:"+quote(str(path.absolute()))+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    try:
        require(db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok","Received database integrity failed.")
        meta=dict(db.execute("SELECT key,value FROM meta"));meta["revision"]=int(meta["revision"])
        require(meta["schema"]=="nelc.workbench/v1" and meta["id"]==manifest["workspace"]["id"],"Received workspace identity differs.")
        expected=1;previous="0"*64;original_head=None
        for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY seq"):
            require(row["seq"]==expected and row["previous_sha"]==previous,"Received operation history is incomplete.")
            request=json.loads(row["request_json"]);response=json.loads(row["result_json"])
            payload={"seq":row["seq"],"id":row["id"],"requestSha256":row["request_sha"],"request":request,"result":response,
                     "createdAt":row["created_at"],"previousSha256":previous}
            require(hashlib.sha256(canonical(request).encode()).hexdigest()==row["request_sha"]
                    and hashlib.sha256(canonical(payload).encode()).hexdigest()==row["sha256"],"A received original operation changed.")
            previous=row["sha256"]
            if expected==manifest["workspace"]["revision"]:original_head=previous
            expected+=1
        require(meta["revision"]==expected-1 and meta["revision"]>=manifest["workspace"]["revision"],"Received revision is inconsistent.")
        if manifest["workspace"]["revision"]==0:original_head="0"*64
        require(original_head==manifest["history"]["headSha256"],"The original accepted history prefix differs.")
        return meta
    finally:db.close()
def _verify_received(directory,manifest,mutable=False,signal=None):
    for entry in manifest["files"]:
        check_stop(signal)
        path=directory/relative(entry["path"])
        require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),"A received member is absent or not ordinary.")
        if mutable and entry["path"]=="workspace/workspace.sqlite":continue
        require(sha_file(path,signal)==(entry["sha256"],entry["bytes"]),"A received source/object differs from its original hash.")
    return db_state(directory/"workspace/workspace.sqlite",manifest)
def receive_archive(archive_path,destination,expected_sha256,maximum_expanded=4*1024**3,signal=None):
    archive_path=Path(archive_path).absolute();destination=Path(destination).absolute()
    require(archive_path.is_file() and not archive_path.is_symlink(),"Choose an ordinary complete archive.")
    actual,size=sha_file(archive_path,signal)
    require(actual==expected_sha256,"The complete archive differs from the selected SHA256.")
    require(not destination.is_symlink(),"A receiving destination cannot be a symlink.")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        infos=archive.infolist();names=[i.filename for i in infos]
        require(len(names)==len(set(names)) and len(names)<=100_000,"Archive names repeat or exceed the supported file count.")
        require("MANIFEST.json" in names and archive.getinfo("MANIFEST.json").file_size<=32*1024*1024,"The full archive manifest is missing or too large.")
        raw=archive.read("MANIFEST.json");manifest=json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        require(manifest.get("schema")=="nelc.portable-workspace/v1","Unsupported workspace archive.")
        entries=manifest.get("files")
        require(isinstance(entries,list) and len({x["path"] for x in entries})==len(entries),"The manifest repeats files.")
        require(set(names)=={"MANIFEST.json"}|{x["path"] for x in entries},"Archive members differ from the manifest.")
        require(not {"RECEIVED.json","RECEIVED.json.pending"}&set(names),"Archive members occupy reserved receiving receipt paths.")
        expanded=sum(i.file_size for i in infos)
        require(expanded<=maximum_expanded,"The archive exceeds the selected expanded-byte budget.")
        for item in infos:
            relative(item.filename);mode=(item.external_attr>>16)&0xFFFF
            require(not item.is_dir() and not stat.S_ISLNK(mode) and (not stat.S_IFMT(mode) or stat.S_ISREG(mode)),
                    "Archive members must be ordinary files.")
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        destination=destination.parent.resolve(strict=True)/destination.name
        require(not destination.is_symlink(),"A receiving destination cannot be a symlink.")
        selected={"archiveSha256":actual,"manifestSha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                  "workspaceId":manifest["workspace"]["id"],"revision":manifest["workspace"]["revision"],
                  "applicationSha256":manifest["applicationSha256"],"destination":str(destination)}
        with artifact_work(destination.parent,"receive",selected,signal) as work:
            staging=work/"received"
            try:
                if destination.exists():
                    receipt_path=destination/"RECEIVED.json"
                    require(receipt_path.is_file() and not receipt_path.is_symlink(),"The receiving destination already contains other work.")
                    receipt=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text("utf-8"))
                    require(receipt.get("archiveSha256")==actual and receipt.get("manifestSha256")==selected["manifestSha256"],
                            "This destination belongs to a different receiving operation.")
                    current=_verify_received(destination,manifest,mutable=True,signal=signal)
                    return {**receipt,"alreadyReceived":True,"currentWorkspace":current}
                require(not staging.is_symlink(),"The original receiving staging path became a symlink.")
                saved=staging/"RECEIVED.json"
                if saved.exists():
                    # Reuse the original complete extraction after a lost rename
                    # acknowledgement, before asking for another full space budget.
                    require(staging.is_dir() and saved.is_file() and not saved.is_symlink(),
                            "The retained receiving staging is not ordinary.")
                    receipt=json.loads(saved.read_text("utf-8"))
                    require(receipt.get("archiveSha256")==actual and receipt.get("manifestSha256")==selected["manifestSha256"]
                            and receipt.get("applicationSha256")==selected["applicationSha256"],
                            "The retained extraction belongs to a different selection.")
                    current=_verify_received(staging,manifest,signal=signal)
                    require(receipt.get("currentWorkspace")==current,"The completed extraction changed before publication.")
                else:
                    # The committed coordinator row proves custody even if the
                    # previous process died while writing a member or its receipt.
                    clear_artifact_work(work,("received",))
                    work.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
                    require(shutil.disk_usage(destination.parent).free>=expanded+32*1024*1024,
                            "The destination lacks the full declared receiving space.")
                    staging.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                    for entry in entries:
                        check_stop(signal)
                        path=staging/relative(entry["path"]);path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                        h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
                        with archive.open(entry["path"]) as source,path.open("xb") as output:
                            for chunk in iter(lambda:source.read(1024*1024),b""):
                                check_stop(signal);count+=len(chunk);require(count<=entry["bytes"],"A received file exceeds its declared size.")
                                h.update(chunk);output.write(chunk)
                            output.flush();os.fsync(output.fileno())
                        require(count==entry["bytes"] and h.hexdigest()==entry["sha256"],"An archive member differs from its original hash.")
                        os.chmod(path,0o600)
                    with (staging/"MANIFEST.json").open("xb") as out:
                        out.write(raw);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
                    for part in ("workspace/exports","workspace/tasks"):(staging/part).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    current=_verify_received(staging,manifest,signal=signal)
                    receipt={"schema":"nelc.receiving-receipt/v1","archiveSha256":actual,"archiveBytes":size,
                             "manifestSha256":selected["manifestSha256"],"originalWorkspace":manifest["workspace"],
                             "currentWorkspace":current,"applicationSha256":manifest["applicationSha256"],"files":len(entries),
                             "destination":str(destination),"alreadyReceived":False}
                    write_artifact_record(staging,"RECEIVED.json",receipt)
                check_stop(signal)
                require(not destination.exists() and not destination.is_symlink(),"The receiving destination was created concurrently.")
                os.rename(staging,destination)
                sync_directory(destination.parent)
                return receipt
            finally:
                # Also reachable after the completed-destination branch. A hard
                # stop before cleanup leaves this exact owner available on retry.
                clear_artifact_work(work,("received",))
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("archive");parser.add_argument("--output",required=True);parser.add_argument("--sha256",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--maximum-expanded-bytes",type=int,default=4*1024**3)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    stop=threading.Event();requested=[];previous={}
    def interrupt(signum,frame):
        if not requested:requested.append(signum)
        stop.set()
    try:
        for signum in (signals.SIGINT,signals.SIGTERM):
            previous[signum]=signals.signal(signum,interrupt)
        result=receive_archive(args.archive,args.output,args.sha256,args.maximum_expanded_bytes,signal=stop)
        print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    except InterruptedError:
        parser.exit(128+(requested[0] if requested else signals.SIGTERM),
                    "The original receiving operation was interrupted; retry with the same archive and destination.\n")
    finally:
        for signum,handler in previous.items():signals.signal(signum,handler)
if __name__=="__main__":main()
